This focus on long-term development and strategic investment reflects a commitment to building for the future, echoing the wisdom of entrusting one's endeavors to divine guidance. May leaders always seek...
reflection.zh: 董建華的遺產包括設立數碼港和香港科學園等重要科技基礎設施。這種對長期發展和戰略投資的關注，體現了為未來建設的承諾，呼應了將事業託付於神聖指引的智慧。願領袖們永遠尋求將他們的計劃和工作託付於雅偉，相信祂必使之堅立。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Northern Metropolis: Hong Kong homes flattened for HK$224 billion high-tech hub
title.zh: 北部都會區：香港房屋被夷平以建造2240億港元高科技中心

summary.en: Chan Yuk-tong, a 71-year-old resident, had hoped to live out his remaining years in his ancestral home in a Hong Kong village. However, his home, along with a significant portion of Hong Kong's land including villages, wetlands, and farmland, is slated for demolition to create the "Northern Metropolis," a massive...
summary.zh: 71歲的陳玉棠原本希望在他出生和長大的藍磚屋村度過餘生，但他的香港鄉村住宅即將被夷為平地，為一個龐大的高科技中心讓路。該項目名為「北部都會區」，佔地相當於香港三分之一的面積，包括村莊、濕地和農田，耗資2240億港元。政府官員已於2026年6月23日在香港北部新界古洞區展開土地收回行動，影響了陳先生和蘇女士等居民。

body.en: Chan Yuk-tong hoped to spend his remaining years in the row of small, blue-brick houses where he was born and raised, but the 71-year-old’s Hong Kong village home will soon be bulldozed to make way for a vast tech hub. Resident Niki So (L1) and her family stand behind the gate of their village house as Hong Kong government officers carry out a land resumption operation against them in the Kwu Tung area of Hong Kong’s northern New Territories, on June 23, 2026. Photo: Leung Man Hei. An area roughly a third of Hong Kong including villages, natural wetlands and farmland is being converted into the “Northern Metropolis”, an ambitious project aimed at deepening integration with the mainland, diversifying the economy and providing new homes. “I can’t bear to leave… If not for the government developing this area, I would likely spend the rest of my life here. After all, I belong here,” Chan told AFP as he packed up belongings in his yard. Touted as a “new economic engine” to accommodate around 2.5 million residents and provide 650,000 jobs, the project will link Hong Kong more closely with Macau and nine cities in mainland China that make up the Greater Bay Area. Embed from Getty Images But the government’s vision for a Silicon Valley-like high-tech hub in Hong Kong comes at a huge cost to the city’s wildlife, local communities and public finances, environmental and social groups warned. “If you build a new city in a place that was well preserved before, it would inevitably be very destructive, no matter how you mitigate it,” said Brian Wong of Liber Research Community, an NGO focused on land issues. “Do we need to build it so big? Is it too ambitious?” he added. Return on investment The Northern Metropolis project, announced five years ago, will eventually cover 30,000 hectares (74,000 acres). Liber said at least 25 villages will be demolished to make way for it. Government departments told AFP they aim to integrate rural areas into the development project, but that Chan’s ancestral houses were not culturally significant enough to preserve. Plans to integrate Hong Kong with mainland China have long faced opposition in the former British colony, where critics warn such moves would erode the city’s autonomy. But a sweeping national security law imposed by Beijing on Hong Kong in 2020 after huge pro-democracy protests has stymied dissent in the financial hub. It “effectively put an end to the ‘one country, two systems’ framework that allowed Hong Kong a ‘high degree of autonomy’, so greater integration with the Greater Bay Area would logically follow,” Steve Tsang, director of the SOAS China Institute, told AFP....
body.zh: 陈玉堂希望能在他出生和长大的一排青砖小房子里度过余生，但这位 71 岁的香港乡村住宅很快就会被推平，为一个巨大的科技中心让路。 2026 年 6 月 23 日，香港政府官员在香港新界北部古洞地区对居民进行收地行动，居民苏妮琪（左一）和她的家人站在村屋门后。照片：梁文熙。香港约三分之一的地区，包括村庄、自然湿地和农田，正在转变为“北方都会区”，这是一个雄心勃勃的项目，旨在深化与内地的融合、经济多元化和提供新家园。 “我舍不得离开……如果不是政府开发这个地区，我可能会在这里度过余生。毕竟，我属于这里，”陈先生在自家院子里收拾行李时告诉法新社。该项目被誉为“新经济引擎”，可容纳约250万居民并提供65万个就业岗位，将更紧密地连接香港与澳门以及构成大湾区的中国内地九个城市。但环境和社会团体警告说，政府在香港建立类似硅谷的高科技中心的愿景是以该市的野生动物、当地社区和公共财政付出巨大代价为代价的。专注于土地问题的非政府组织 Liber Research Community 的布莱恩·王 (Brian Wong) 表示：“如果你在以前保存完好的地方建造一座新城市，无论你如何减轻影响，都将不可避免地造成很大的破坏。” “我们需要把它建得这么大吗？是不是太雄心勃勃了？”他补充道。投资回报五年前宣布的北方都市项目最终将占地 30,000 公顷（74,000 英亩）。利伯表示，至少有 25 个村庄将被拆除，为其让路。政府部门告诉法新社，他们的目标是将农村地区纳入开发项目，但陈氏祖屋的文化意义不足以保护。香港与中国大陆融合的计划长期以来一直遭到这个前英国殖民地的反对，批评人士警告称，此类举措将削弱香港的自治权。但在大规模的民主抗议活动之后，北京于 2020 年对香港实施了一项全面的国家安全法，平息了这个金融中心的异议。伦敦亚非学院中国研究院院长曾锐生告诉法新社，它“有效地结束了允许香港‘高度自治’的‘一国两制’框架，因此顺理成章地与大湾区进一步融合。”

reflection.en: The development of Hong Kong's "Northern Metropolis" promises technological advancement but displaces long-time residents like 71-year-old Chan Yuk-tong from their homes. This raises questions about the balance between progress and the human cost, particularly for those rooted in their communities. Jeremiah 22:3 calls rulers to "execute justice and...
reflection.zh: 香港「北部都會區」的發展承諾帶來科技進步，卻也迫使像71歲的陳玉棠這樣的長期居民離開他們的家園。這引發了關於發展與人類代價之間平衡的質疑，特別是對那些根植於社區的人們。耶利米書22:3呼籲統治者「施行公平和公義，拯救被欺壓的脫離欺壓者的手。」願領導者在他們宏偉的規劃中，永遠顧念所有人民的福祉，尤其是弱勢群體。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: CE to wear lapel pin symbolising HK's blueprint
title.zh: 港特首将佩戴象征香港蓝图的翻领徽章

summary.en: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee announced on Sunday that he will wear a lapel pin symbolizing the city's first five-year plan when he delivers the blueprint and Policy Address on Wednesday. He and his team will also wear green ties and scarves, with all items designed by a team at the Technological and Higher...
summary.zh: 香港行政长官李家超周日表示，他将于周三发表施政报告及蓝图时，佩戴象征香港首个五年计划的翻领徽章。他及其团队还将佩戴绿色领带和围巾，所有物品均由香港高等教育科技学院的团队设计。蓝色的翻领徽章上印有“一五”字样，代表香港的首个五年计划，并象征香港汇聚各方资源和多元人才，全面深化高质量发展的理念。

body.en: Chief Executive John Lee on Sunday said he would wear a lapel pin symbolising the city’s first five-year plan while delivering the blueprint and Policy Address on Wednesday. Writing on his social media, Lee said he and his team would also wear green ties and scarves – all of which, along with the lapel pins, were designed by a team at the Technological and Higher Education Institute. “The blue lapel pin bears the word ‘one five’, representing Hong Kong’s first five-year plan,” he said. “The pattern is based on the idea of two overlapping squares, symbolising that Hong Kong brings together resources and diverse talent from all quarters of society, comprehensively deepens high-quality development, consolidates and enhances its economic strength and competitiveness, and shines on the international stage. “The designs of the ties and scarves draw inspiration from the technological development of the Northern Metropolis, symbolising it will lead Hong Kong in pioneering a new landscape for innovation and technology.” Lee added that the criss-crossing design on the tie symbolises connectivity and synergy among talent, education and industries. Edited by Tony Sabine
body.zh: 行政长官李家超周日表示，他将在周三发表蓝图和施政报告时佩戴象征香港第一个五年计划的徽章。李在他的社交媒体上写道，他和他的团队还将佩戴绿色领带和围巾——所有这些以及翻领别针都是由技术与高等教育学院的一个团队设计的。 “蓝色领章上有‘一五’字样，代表香港的第一个五年计划，”他说。 “图案以两个正方形重叠为概念，象征香港汇聚社会各方面资源和多元人才，全面深化高质量发展，巩固和提升经济实力和竞争力，在国际舞台上大放异彩。领带和丝巾的设计灵感来自北方大都市的科技发展，象征香港将引领香港开创创新科技新格局。”李补充说，领带上纵横交错的设计象征着人才、教育和产业之间的联系和协同。托尼·萨宾编辑

reflection.en: The Chief Executive's symbolic attire for the Policy Address underscores the importance of vision and purpose in governance. As leaders present their plans, they are called to embody the principles of justice and righteousness, ensuring their policies serve the well-being of all citizens, especially the vulnerable.
reflection.zh: 行政长官为施政报告选择的象征性着装，强调了治理中的愿景和目标的重要性。当领导者提出他们的计划时，他们被呼召要体现公正和公义的原则，确保他们的政策能服务于所有市民的福祉，特别是弱势群体。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Tung Chee-hwa lauded for contributions to HK
title.zh: 悼念董建华对香港的贡献

summary.en: Political leaders who worked with Hong Kong's first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, paid tribute to him on Sunday, remembering his foresight and significant contributions to the city's development. Tung passed away on Tuesday at the age of 89. Tributes noted his patience in listening to opposing views during major...
summary.zh: 与香港首任行政长官董建华共事的政界人士周日向这位已故领导人致敬，赞扬他的远见卓识和对香港发展的重大贡献。董建华于周二去世，享年89岁。悼词中提到，他在处理重大危机时，总是耐心倾听不同意见。

body.en: Several political heavyweights who worked with Hong Kong's first chief executive, Tung Chee-hwa, paid tribute to the late leader on Sunday, praising his foresight and major contributions to the city's development. Tung passed away on Tuesday at the age of 89. Speaking on a Commercial Radio programme, Elsie Leung, who served as Secretary for Justice during Tung’s administration, remembered him as a far-sighted leader. She noted that Tung was always willing to listen to opposing views when handling major crises, such as the right of abode and illegal immigration disputes, as well as the reform of the rural representative election system. “First of all, he was always patient enough to hear people out. Whether he agreed or not, he would listen until you had finished, and we had to explain our positions clearly to him,” Leung said. “He also enjoyed immense trust from the central government. On many issues, he clearly conveyed Hong Kong's actual situation to the central government. With that strong backing behind us, we had the confidence to take bold steps when needed: such as requesting an interpretation of the Basic Law from the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC).” Looking back at the steep challenges of the early post-1997 years, Leung recalled Tung’s belief that true leadership demands selflessness, free from deceit, resentment, and regret. She added that the government at the time was highly transparent, maintaining open dialogue with the opposition and even sharing sensitive information, such as plans to seek the an interpretation of the Basic Law from the NPCSC. On the same programme, Tam Yiu-chung, who served on the Executive Council under Tung, praised Tung as a major contributor to the city's stability and development. Tam, now a consultant for the Chinese Association of Hong Kong and Macao Studies, also lauded the late leader for his profound understanding of the "One Country, Two Systems" principle and his early push for Hong Kong to integrate into the country’s broader development. “He saw the close ties between the country and Hong Kong. Today, we say we must integrate into the broader national development as the best path forward for our city. But he recognised that connection long ago, constantly reminding us that when the country prospers, Hong Kong prospers too,” he said. Tam added that Tung consistently stepped up for Hong Kong during pivotal moments. As an example, he pointed to Tung establishing the Our Hong Kong Foundation following the 2014 Occupy Central movement to unite different sectors and pool wisdom to solve deep-seated social issues. Fanny Law, who served as Director of the first HKSAR Chief Executive Elect’s Office in 1997, described Tung as both demanding and approachable, treating everyone with...
body.zh: 周日，与香港首​​任行政长官董建华共事的几位政治重量级人物向这位已故领导人致敬，赞扬他的远见卓识和对香港发展的重大贡献。董建华周二去世，享年 89 岁。曾在董建华执政期间担任律政司司长的梁爱诗在商业电台节目中表示，董建华是一位有远见的领导人。她表示，董建华在处理居留权、非法移民纠纷、乡代表选举制度改革等重大危机时，总是愿意听取反对意见。 “首先，他总是有足够的耐心听别人说。无论他同意与否，他都会听直到你说完，我们必须向他清楚地解释我们的立场，”梁说。 “他也得到中央政府的极大信任。在很多问题上，他向中央政府清楚地传达了香港的实际情况。有了这样的坚强后盾，我们有信心在需要时采取大胆的步骤：例如向全国人民代表大会常务委员会提出对《基本法》的解释。”回顾1997年后初期的严峻挑战，梁振英回忆起董先生的信念，即真正的领导力需要无私，没有欺骗、怨恨和遗憾。她补充说，当时的政府高度透明，与反对派保持公开对话，甚至分享敏感信息，例如计划向全国人大常委会寻求对《基本法》的解释。在同一节目中，曾在董建华领导下的行政会议任职的谭耀宗称赞董建华是香港稳定和发展的主要贡献者。现任全国港澳研究会顾问的谭先生也赞扬已故领导人对“一国两制”原则的深刻理解以及他早期推动香港融入国家更广泛发展的努力。 “他看到了国家和香港之间的密切联系。今天，我们说我们必须融入国家发展大局，这是我们城市前进的最佳道路。但他很早就认识到这种联系，不断提醒我们，国家繁荣，香港繁荣，”他说。谭俊荣补充说，董建华在关键时刻始终为香港挺身而出。他举例说，董建华在2014年“占中”运动后成立了团结香港基金，旨在团结各界、汇聚智慧，解决深层次的社会问题。 1997年担任香港首任候任行政长官办公室主任的罗范椒芬形容董建华既要求严格又平易近人，对待每个人都一视同仁。

reflection.en: The passing of Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first chief executive, prompts reflection on leadership. His former colleagues recall his foresight and, notably, his patience in listening to opposing views during challenging times. This echoes the wisdom found in Proverbs, which emphasizes the value of counsel in navigating complex issues and making sound...
reflection.zh: 香港首任行政长官董建华的逝世，引发了对领导力的反思。他的前同事们回忆起他的远见卓识，尤其是在充满挑战的时期，他耐心倾听不同意见。这与《箴言书》中的智慧相呼应，该书强调了在处理复杂问题和为社区做出明智决策时，寻求建议的价值。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Macau to hold closed-door trial in first national security case against democrat
title.zh: 澳门将在首次国家安全案中对民主派人士进行不公开审判

summary.en: Macau is set to hold its first national security trial next week behind closed doors for a former pro-democracy lawmaker accused of "subversion." This follows an expansion of national security laws in May 2023 and a new bill allowing closed-door hearings in such cases, raising concerns among legal experts and rights...
summary.zh: 澳门法院周五表示，下周将就首起国家安全案件举行不公开审判，被告是一名被控“颠覆罪”的前亲民主议员。此前，中国这个博彩中心于2023年5月扩大了国家安全法的适用范围，并于今年早些时候通过了一项新法案，允许法官在国家安全案件中进行不公开审理。律师和人权组织警告称，此规定可能会破坏政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。

body.en: Macau will hold its first national security trial behind closed doors next week, a court said on Friday, in a case against a former pro-democracy lawmaker charged with “subversion”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San. File photo: Au Kam San, via Facebook. The Chinese casino hub expanded the scope of national security laws in May 2023, and a new bill passed earlier this year allows judges to hear national security cases behind closed doors. Lawyers and rights groups have warned that the rule could undermine the functioning of government departments and apply to “any judicial case”. Former Macau lawmaker Au Kam San in July 2025 became the first person to be arrested under the expanded law, with authorities alleging he had ties to foreign groups endangering China. The judge decided to “hold the trial behind closed doors in order to ensure that national security interests are not compromised”, a statement released by Macau’s final appeals court said. After Au’s arrest, details about the case remained scarce until this July, when judicial authorities in Macau confirmed that he would stand trial as a “principal offender” of subversion and other crimes. The court said the trial decision had been confirmed by Macau’s national security committee, following a request from the city’s public prosecutions office. The proceedings are set to begin September 16. Au, 69, is a primary school teacher who became one of Macau’s longest-serving pro-democracy legislators before deciding not to seek re-election in 2021. Authorities said that a court-appointed lawyer previously accepted by Au will continue to represent him. Macau flag. Photo: gavindeas, via Flickr. Michael Polak, a London-based barrister representing Au, said earlier this year that authorities having “appointed a state lawyer does not remedy the fundamental deficiencies in these proceedings which have all the appearances of a show trial”. “He is a Portuguese national and has been kept incommunicado for one year without access to his family or an independent lawyer,” Polak added. Au’s daughter Cherry said the family is not allowed to visit or communicate with him. “All we ask for is a fair trial, due process, and for his more than three decades of dedication to the people of Macau not to be erased or forgotten,” she said in a statement in July. Under Macau’s security law, subversion offences are subject to a prison term of up to 25 years.
body.zh: 一家法院周五表示，澳门将于下周举行首次国家安全审判，审理一名被控“颠覆国家政权”的前民主派议员的案件。前澳门议员区锦新。资料图：区金山，来自 Facebook。中国赌场中心于 2023 年 5 月扩大了国家安全法的范围，今年早些时候通过的一项新法案允许法官闭门审理国家安全案件。律师和人权组织警告说，该规则可能会损害政府部门的运作，并适用于“任何司法案件”。 2025 年 7 月，前澳门议员区锦新成为根据扩大后的法律被捕的第一人，当局指控他与危害中国的外国组织有联系。澳门终审法院发布的一份声明称，法官决定“闭门审理，以确保国家安全利益不受影响”。区被捕后，有关案件的细节一直很少，直到今年7月，澳门司法当局确认他将作为颠覆国家政权和其他罪行的“主犯”接受审判。法院表示，应澳门检察机关的要求，澳门国家安全委员会确认了审判决定。诉讼程序定于 9 月 16 日开始。区先生现年 69 岁，是一名小学教师，在决定不再寻求 2021 年连任之前，他成为澳门任职时间最长的民主派立法会议员之一。当局表示，区先生之前接受的一名法院指定的律师将继续代表他。澳门旗。照片：gavindeas，来自 Flickr。代表 Au 的驻伦敦大律师迈克尔·波拉克 (Michael Polak) 今年早些时候表示，当局“任命一名国家律师并没有弥补这些诉讼程序中的根本缺陷，这些诉讼程序看起来像是一场表演审判”。波拉克补充说：“他是葡萄牙国民，已被单独监禁一年，无法与家人或独立律师见面。” Au的女儿Cherry表示，家人不被允许探望或与他交流。她在七月的一份声明中表示：“我们所要求的只是公平审判、正当程序，以及他三十多年来对澳门人民的奉献不被抹去或遗忘。”根据澳门国安法，颠覆罪可被判处最高25年监禁。

reflection.en: The news from Macau, where a former lawmaker faces trial behind closed doors for alleged subversion, evokes Proverbs 28:15: "Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a poor people." The secrecy surrounding the trial raises concerns about justice and the potential for unchecked power to silence dissent, echoing the prophet's warning...
reflection.zh: 澳门前议员因涉嫌“颠覆罪”面临不公开审判的消息，令人联想起《箴言》28章15节：“恶劣的统治者统治贫苦的民众，如同咆哮的狮子或凶猛的熊。”审判的秘密性引发了对公正的担忧，以及不受制约的权力压制异议的可能性，这与先知对压迫性领导的警告不谋而合。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Yu Zidi: China’s fearless swimming prodigy, 13, with Olympics in her sights
title.zh: 余梓迪：中国无畏的游泳天才，13岁，奥运在望

summary.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut...
summary.zh: 余梓迪去年12岁时创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛最年轻的奖牌得主。如今已是青少年，她领衔中国队争夺亚运会霸主地位，并以奥运荣耀为目标。这位13岁的留着精灵短发的在校女生……

body.en: Yu Zidi made history last year aged 12 when she became the youngest-ever medallist at the swimming world championships. Now a teenager, she headlines China’s bid for Asian Games domination and has Olympic glory in her sights. China’s swimmer Yu Zidi prepares for the final of the women’s 200m butterfly swimming event during the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore on July 31, 2025. Photo: Oli Scarff/AFP. The 13-year-old school girl with a pixie hair cut stunned the sporting world last year with a series of eye-popping times. At the 2025 World Aquatics Championships in Singapore she helped China reach the 4x200m women’s freestyle relay final. She did not swim in the final but China came third, earning Yu a historic bronze for swimming in the heats. Yu just missed out on medals in the 200m and 400m individual medley events and the 200m butterfly, coming fourth in all three races. In November at China’s National Games, having just turned 13, she clocked a blistering 2:07.41 in the women’s 200m medley for what was then an Asian record. While training with the China team in Beijing, she told local media this month she was “excited” for her Asian Games debut. “Train well, don’t slack off. Demonstrate the level of your training and work hard to break past yourself,” she said, according to state news agency Xinhua. The Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan open on September 19. Pressure ‘like a stone’ A coach, Ha Sinan, once described Yu with a Chinese saying that translates as “a newborn calf fearless of tigers”. But the teenager has spoken of struggling to deal with the heavy load placed on her. Yu grew up in the city of Baoding, about 150 kilometres (90 miles) south of Beijing. She started swimming aged six and since then has juggled schoolwork with training. “Being in class all day and still having to train was really tiring,” she said in January. “Sometimes I was so tired I could fall asleep even while eating,” she said at an event celebrating Hebei province’s National Games wins. Yu said she “never considered quitting” and always dreamed of being a national champion. But during the tune-up to last year’s National Games she said the pressure of wanting to win the 400m medley nearly became too much. “It was like a big stone that weighed on me and made it hard to breathe,” she said. Yu eventually told her coach she wanted to do anything other than train. Her coach told her to persevere and “believe in yourself”, she said. Yu went on to win four medals at the National Games. Some in the swimming world have questioned the mental and physical impact of high-level training and competing on Yu...
body.zh: 去年，12岁的于紫迪创造了历史，成为游泳世锦赛上最年轻的奖牌获得者。如今，十几岁的她成为中国争夺亚运会冠军的头条新闻，并瞄准了奥运会的荣耀。 2025 年 7 月 31 日，在新加坡举行的 2025 年世界游泳锦标赛上，中国游泳运动员于子迪正在备战女子 200 米蝶泳决赛。照片：Oli Scarff/法新社。这位留着精灵发型的 13 岁女学生去年以一系列令人瞠目结舌的成绩震惊了体育界。在2025年新加坡世界游泳锦标赛上，她帮助中国队进入了女子4x200米自由泳接力决赛。她没有参加决赛，但中国队获得了第三名，为余在预赛中获得历史性的铜牌。于刚在200米和400米个人混合泳以及200米蝶泳项目中错失奖牌，在所有三场比赛中均获得第四名。 11月的中国全运会上，刚满13岁的她在女子200米混合泳中取得了惊人的2分07.41秒的成绩，创造了当时的亚洲纪录。在北京与中国队一起训练时，她本月对当地媒体表示，她对自己的亚运首秀感到“兴奋”。据官方通讯社新华社报道，她说：“好好训练，不要懈怠。展示你的训练水平，努力突破自己。”日本爱知名古屋亚运会将于9月19日开幕。压力“如石” 教练哈斯南曾用中国的一句话来形容于玉，“初生牛犊不怕虎”。但这位少女表示，她正在努力应对所承受的沉重负担。于在北京以南约 150 公里（90 英里）的保定市长大。她六岁开始游泳，从那时起她就兼顾学业和训练。 “一整天都在课堂上，而且还要训练，真的很累，”她在一月份说道。 “有时我太累了，连吃饭的时候都能睡着，”她在庆祝河北省全运会胜利的活动中说道。于说她“从未考虑过放弃”，一直梦想着成为全国冠军。但在去年全运会的备战期间，她表示想要赢得 4 亿米混合泳冠军的压力几乎变得太大了。 “这就像一块大石头压在我身上，让我呼吸困难，”她说。于最终告诉她的教练，除了训练之外，她想做任何事情。她说，她的教练告诉她要坚持下去并“相信自己”。于随后在全运会上赢得了四枚奖牌。游泳界的一些人质疑高水平训练和比赛对运动员心理和身体的影响……

reflection.en: At just 13, Yu Zidi is already making waves, aiming for the highest levels of competitive swimming. Her journey embodies the dedication and discipline required to pursue athletic excellence, reminding us of the Apostle Paul's exhortation to run with all our might for the prize that is imperishable. May her youthful ambition inspire perseverance in all...
reflection.zh: 年仅13岁的余梓迪已在泳坛掀起波澜，朝着竞技游泳的最高殿堂迈进。她的旅程体现了追求卓越体育成就所需的奉献和纪律，提醒我们使徒保罗的劝勉：要竭力奔跑，去赢得那永不朽坏的冠冕。 愿她年轻的志向激励我们在所有事业中坚持不懈，无论是在体育、学业还是信仰上，尽我们所能，因为我们知道真正的奖赏超越世俗的赞誉。

verse.textEn: Do you not know that in a race all the runners run, but only one gets the prize? Run in such a way as to get the prize.
verse.textZh: 岂不知在场上赛跑的都跑，但得奖赏的只有一人？你们也当这样跑，好叫你们得着奖赏。

title.en: Tiananmen Square vigil organisers jailed for seven years in Hong Kong
title.zh: 香港国安法下，支联会前正副主席煽动颠覆罪成判囚七年

summary.en: Hong Kong activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan have been sentenced to seven years in prison after being found guilty of inciting subversion under the city's national security law for their roles in organizing an annual vigil commemorating the Tiananmen Square massacre.
summary.zh: 香港活动人士周庭栋和李卓人因在组织纪念天安门事件的年度集会中煽动颠覆国家政权，根据香港国安法被判处七年监禁。

body.en: Pro-democracy activists Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan were found guilty of ‘incitement to subversion’ in controversial national security case Two pro-democracy activists who were put on trial for organising an annual Tiananmen Square massacre vigil in Hong Kong have been sentenced to seven years in jail, in one of the city’s most significant national security cases. Chow Hang-tung, 41 and Lee Cheuk-yan, 69, were found guilty in August of incitement to subversion . The court found they had “incited other persons to organise, plan, commit or participate in acts by unlawful means with a view to subverting the state power”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 民主活动人士周恒东和李卓人在有争议的国家安全案件中被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。两名因在香港组织一年一度的天安门广场大屠杀守夜活动而受审的民主活动人士被判处七年监禁，这是香港最重大的国家安全案件之一。 41 岁的周恒东和 69 岁的李卓人于 8 月被判犯有煽动颠覆罪。法院认为，他们“煽动他人以非法手段组织、策划、实施或者参与颠覆国家政权的行为”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The sentencing of Chow Hang-tung and Lee Cheuk-yan highlights a profound tension between civic duty and conscience. Their conviction for organizing a Tiananmen Square vigil raises questions about the limits of free expression and assembly when they are perceived to challenge state power. The principle of obeying God over human authorities, even when it...
reflection.zh: 周庭栋和李卓人的判刑凸显了公民责任与良知之间的深刻张力。他们因组织天安门事件悼念集会被定罪，引发了关于言论和集会自由界限的疑问，尤其是在这些自由被视为挑战国家权力之时。即使面临世俗的惩罚，也要优先顺服雅伟而非人间的命令，这一原则在这样的处境中引起了深刻共鸣。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Wall Street Journal publisher convicted in Hong Kong of deterring reporter from union role
title.zh: 《华尔街日报》出版商在香港被判犯有阻止记者担任工会职务的罪名

summary.en: Dow Jones, the publisher of The Wall Street Journal, has been convicted in a Hong Kong court of one count of deterring reporter Selina Cheng from taking up a role at the Hong Kong Journalist Association. The case raised concerns about press freedom in the city, as Cheng was dismissed weeks after her appointment as...
summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》的出版商道琼斯公司在香港一家法院被判犯有一项阻止记者郑丽莎担任香港记者协会职务的罪名。此案引发了对该市新闻自由的担忧，郑女士在2024年被任命为香港记协主席数周后被公司以重组为由解雇。

body.en: Dow Jones convicted of one count of deterring Selina Cheng from role at Hong Kong Journalist Association but cleared of second charge A Hong Kong court has convicted the publisher of the Wall Street Journal of deterring a reporter from taking up a trade union role, in a case that raised concerns about press freedom in the city. The newspaper dismissed Selina Cheng just weeks after she was appointed chair of the Hong Kong Journalist Association (HKJA) in 2024. She was told at the time her termination was officially due to restructuring. Continue reading...
body.zh: 道琼斯因一项阻止郑秀玲在香港记者协会任职的罪名被定罪，但第二项指控被洗清。香港一家法院判定《华尔街日报》出版商阻止一名记者担任工会职务的罪名成立，此案引起了人们对香港新闻自由的担忧。该报在 2024 年被任命为香港记者协会 (HKJA) 主席几周后解雇了郑嘉颖。当时她被告知，她的解雇正式是由于重组。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The conviction of Dow Jones in Hong Kong for deterring a reporter from union activity underscores a troubling trend where corporate actions can stifle worker advocacy. The prophet Micah reminds us that true righteousness involves acting justly and loving mercy, even in the face of corporate restructuring or perceived inconvenience. May we pray for leaders...
reflection.zh: 道琼斯公司在香港被判阻止记者参与工会活动，这凸显了一个令人担忧的趋势：企业行为可能扼杀工人维权。先知弥迦提醒我们，真正的公义在于秉行公义，喜爱怜悯，即使面对企业重组或所谓的“不便”。愿我们为媒体和商业界的领导者祈祷，愿他们坚守这些原则，确保追求利润不会掩盖员工的基本权利和尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 一群儿时的朋友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪，这是一部低成本的喜剧冒险片，它挑战了叙事的极限。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大但结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，其手法充满喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。当他们七岁时，儿时的朋友马克（凌...

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes the allure of sensationalized true crime stories and the influencers who amplify them. It reminds us that even fictional accounts can captivate an entire city, highlighting the importance of discernment in separating fact from fiction and resisting the urge to be swept away by compelling narratives without critical thought. In...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以戏谑的方式讽刺了耸人听闻的真实犯罪故事以及放大这些故事的影响者。它提醒我们，即使是虚构的故事也能吸引整座城市，这突显了在区分事实与虚构以及抵制被引人入胜的故事所迷惑而放弃批判性思考的重要性。 在这个信息泛滥的世界里，辨别真理的能力是一项至关重要的技能。让我们寻求智慧来解读我们所接触的故事，用清醒的头脑和一颗向往真理的心去评估它们。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Ancient armored fish evolved two distinct ways to crush prey 385 million years ago
title.zh: 3.85亿年前的古代盔甲鱼进化出两种截然不同的捕食方式

summary.en: Researchers have discovered that placoderms, an ancient group of armored fish that lived over 400 million years ago, evolved two distinct strategies for crushing their prey, showcasing early vertebrate predatory adaptations.
summary.zh: 研究人员发现，生活在4亿多年前的盾皮鱼类——一种古代盔甲鱼类——进化出了两种截然不同的压碎猎物的策略，展示了早期脊椎动物的捕食适应性。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Long before dinosaurs appeared on Earth, fierce predatory fish developed crushing jaws and sharp teeth to survive and diversify in ancient oceans.

Flinders University researchers have used a new combination of techniques to find out how these armored fish called placoderms—the first vertebrates to evolve jaws and teeth more than 400 million years ago—caught their prey on an exotic ancient reef that once covered what is now northern Western Australia.

The scientists were surprised to discover these early jawed fish evolved two different ways of biting other armored prey in the rich marine ecosystems of prehistoric Australia.

"Placoderms experimented with an extraordinary range of jaw shapes and biting parts during the early evolution of vertebrates," says Dr. Alice Clement, an ARC Future Fellow. "They provide a rare opportunity to understand how some of the first jaws became specialized for different diets."

While the smaller species examined relied on broad, flat crushing plates to pulverize whole prey, the larger species evolved weapon-like teeth that pierced and broke apart shelled and armored prey that were too large to swallow.

"We know that animals feeding on hard foods usually evolve stronger jaws and broader, flatter crushing surfaces, but that's not exactly what we found in this analysis," Clement says.

The researchers used a new finite element analysis technique, with computer-based simulations and three-dimensional analysis of their biting surfaces, to reconstruct how eight of these species fed in the oceans 385 million years ago.

Dr. Rex Mitchell, the first author of the study published in Scientific Reports , studies the relationship between diet and skull shape to explain ecology and evolution.

"Unlike many animals around today, including humans, placoderms did not possess a single lower jaw bone. Instead, their jaws consisted of paired bony plates supported by cartilage, with surfaces ranging from broad crushing plates to sharp slicing edges with tooth-like structures," Mitchell says.

The researchers performed digital bite simulations on 3D models of the fossil jaw bones to measure how well they supported biting forces before comparing these results with the complexity of each species' biting surface.

Rather than finding a simple relationship, they discovered that both the largest and smallest placoderms possessed the strongest jaws for handling hard bites, despite using completely different biting tools. The smallest species had broad, almost featureless crushing plates, while the largest species possessed highly complex, elevated dental...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 早在恐龙出现在地球上之前，凶猛的掠食性鱼类就已经进化出了具有破碎作用的下颌和锋利的牙齿，以便在古代海洋中生存并实现多样化。 弗林德斯大学的研究人员使用了一种新的技术组合来查明这些被称为盾皮鱼的铠甲鱼（4亿多年前最早进化出下巴和牙齿的脊椎动物）是如何在曾经覆盖现在西澳大利亚北部地区的奇异古代珊瑚礁上捕获猎物的。 科学家们惊讶地发现，这些早期有颌鱼类在史前澳大利亚丰富的海洋生态系统中进化出了两种不同的咬合其他装甲猎物的方式。 “在脊椎动物的早期进化过程中，盾皮鱼尝试了一系列非凡的下巴形状和咬合部位，”ARC 未来研究员爱丽丝·克莱门特 (Alice Clement) 博士说。 “它们提供了一个难得的机会来了解一些最早的颌骨是如何专门适应不同饮食的。” 虽然较小的物种依靠宽而平坦的破碎板来粉碎整个猎物，但较大的物种进化出了类似武器的牙齿，可以刺穿并分解太大而难以吞咽的带壳和装甲猎物。 克莱门特说：“我们知道，以坚硬食物为食的动物通常会进化出更强壮的下巴和更宽、更平坦的破碎表面，但这并不是我们在这次分析中发现的。” 研究人员使用一种新的有限元分析技术，通过基于计算机的模拟和对其咬合表面的三维分析，重建了其中八个物种在 3.85 亿年前如何在海洋中进食的情况。 该研究的第一作者雷克斯·米切尔博士发表在《科学报告》上，他研究饮食与头骨形状之间的关系，以解释生态学和进化论。 米切尔说：“与当今包括人类在内的许多动物不同，盾皮鱼没有一块下颌骨。相反，它们的下颌由软骨支撑的成对骨板组成，表面从宽阔的破碎板到带有齿状结构的锋利切片边缘。” 研究人员对化石颌骨的 3D 模型进行了数字咬合模拟，以测量它们对咬合力的支持程度，然后将这些结果与每个物种咬合表面的复杂性进行比较。 他们没有找到简单的关系，而是发现最大和最小的盾皮鱼都拥有最强的下颌来处理硬咬合，尽管使用完全不同的咬合工具。最小的物种有宽阔的、几乎没有特征的破碎板，而最大的物种则拥有高度复杂、高高的牙齿……

reflection.en: The discovery of how ancient placoderms developed specialized jaws for crushing prey millions of years ago is a testament to the intricate design and adaptability within creation. It reminds us that by observing the natural world, we can gain profound insights into the Creator's wisdom and the diverse ways life has flourished.
reflection.zh: 发现古代盾皮鱼类在数百万年前进化出专门用于压碎猎物的颌骨，证明了造物中精妙的设计和适应性。这提醒我们，通过观察自然世界，我们可以深刻地理解造物主的智慧以及生命蓬勃发展的多样方式。

title.en: Venus’s pale yellow clouds may hide something surprisingly dark
title.zh: 金星的淡黄色云层可能隐藏着令人惊讶的黑暗事物

summary.en: A century-old mystery surrounding the unidentified material causing dark ultraviolet patterns in Venus's clouds has become more intriguing. New calculations by scientists have placed numerical limits on how strongly this substance must absorb light, potentially aiding future spacecraft in its identification.
summary.zh: 金星云层中导致紫外线图案变暗的未知物质的百年之谜变得更加引人入胜。科学家的新计算已将这种物质必须吸收光线的强度设定了数值上限，这可能有助于未来的航天器对其进行识别。

body.en:
Venus looks pale yellow in ordinary visible light, but the view changes dramatically in ultraviolet wavelengths. There, dark and bright features sweep across the planet's upper sulfuric acid clouds. Scientists have observed these patterns for about a century, yet the substance producing them, known as the "unknown absorber," has never been identified.

Now, an international team of researchers has placed new numerical limits on what this mysterious material must be like. Using observations of Venus together with radiative-transfer modeling, the scientists estimated how strongly the liquid inside the planet's cloud droplets would need to absorb ultraviolet and blue light to match what spacecraft and telescopes observe.

The study, published in Astrobiology , examined the problem in an unusual way. Lead author Dr. Jan Spacek asked what Venus's cloud material might look like if the droplets could somehow be collected into a spectrometric cuvette and studied as a bulk liquid.

That distinction matters because a cloud can look very different from the material that actually makes up its particles.

Cigarette smoke offers a familiar example. Smoke can appear white because its sub-micrometer particles scatter light extremely effectively. But if those particles are collected inside a flask, they form a dense suspension of burned tobacco -- a tar-like sludge.

Venus's clouds may behave according to a similar optical principle because their particle size distribution is comparable to that of cigarette smoke. As a result, clouds that look pale yellow from far away could contain liquid that appears surprisingly dark when concentrated.

"Our model effectively asks what would happen if we could collect that cloud material into a cuvette and put it into a laboratory spectrometer," said lead author Jan Spacek of the Foundation for Applied Molecular Evolution, USA. "This is important, as light absorption in a bulk liquid may be correlated with the concentration of light-absorbing material in the solution."

To make that comparison possible, the researchers combined observations of Venus with a radiative-transfer model that tracks how light is repeatedly scattered and absorbed by cloud droplets and atmospheric molecules.

They then converted the astronomical measurements into something commonly used in laboratory UV-visible spectroscopy: the absorption coefficient of the liquid making up the cloud droplets.

"The key is that Venus's cloud particles scatter sunlight very efficiently, so the brightness observed from space cannot be directly compared with the absorption of a bulk liquid measured in the laboratory," said Dr. Yeon Joo Lee of the Planetary Atmospheres Group within the Institute for Basic Science (IBS), S. Korea, who performed the radiative-transfer model...
body.zh: 金星在普通可见光下看起来呈淡黄色，但在紫外线波长下，视野会发生巨大变化。在那里，黑暗和明亮的特征席卷了行星的上层硫酸云。科学家们观察这些模式大约一个世纪了，但产生这些模式的物质（被称为“未知吸收剂”）从未被识别出来。 现在，一个国际研究小组对这种神秘材料的样子设定了新的数值限制。通过对金星的观测以及辐射传输模型，科学家们估计了金星云滴内的液体需要吸收紫外线和蓝光的强度，才能与航天器和望远镜的观测结果相匹配。 这项发表在《天体生物学》上的研究以一种不寻常的方式研究了这个问题。主要作者 Jan Spacek 博士询问，如果能够以某种方式将液滴收集到光谱比色皿中并作为散装液体进行研究，金星的云物质会是什么样子。 这种区别很重要，因为云看起来可能与实际构成其粒子的材料非常不同。 香烟烟雾就是一个常见的例子。烟雾之所以呈现白色，是因为其亚微米颗粒能极其有效地散射光线。但如果这些颗粒被收集在烧瓶内，它们就会形成燃烧烟草的浓密悬浮液——一种焦油状的污泥。 金星云的行为可能遵循类似的光学原理，因为它们的颗粒尺寸分布与香烟烟雾的颗粒尺寸分布相当。因此，从远处看呈淡黄色的云可能含有液体，当浓缩时，这些液体会显得出奇的暗。 美国应用分子进化基金会的主要作者扬·斯派克（Jan Spacek）说：“我们的模型有效地询问了如果我们能够将这些云物质收集到比色皿中并将其放入实验室光谱仪中会发生什么。” “这很重要，因为散装液体中的光吸收可能与溶液中光吸收材料的浓度相关。” 为了使这种比较成为可能，研究人员将对金星的观测与辐射传输模型结合起来，该模型跟踪光如何被云滴和大气分子反复散射和吸收。 然后，他们将天文测量结果转换为实验室紫外可见光谱中常用的东西：构成云滴的液体的吸收系数。 韩国基础科学研究所 (IBS) 行星大气小组的 Yeon Joo Lee 博士负责执行辐射传输模型，他说：“关键是金星的云粒子非常有效地散射阳光，因此从太空观测到的亮度不能直接与实验室中测量的大量液体的吸收进行比较。”

reflection.en: The vastness of creation, even on a planet like Venus, continues to hold mysteries that invite human curiosity and scientific inquiry. As we observe the heavens and the intricate workings of the universe, we are reminded that wisdom and understanding can be found in the created order, pointing to a Creator who designed it all with purpose. As scientists...
reflection.zh: 即使在金星这样的行星上，浩瀚的造物依然充满了奥秘，激发着人类的好奇心和科学探索。当我们观察天空和宇宙错综复杂的运作时，我们被提醒，智慧和理解可以在被造的秩序中找到，这指向一位以目的创造了这一切的造物主。...

title.en: Scientists find water was fueling volcanoes 3 billion years ago
title.zh: 科学家发现30亿年前火山活动由水驱动

summary.en: Ancient rocks from Western Australia suggest that water was reaching deep inside the Earth more than three billion years ago, influencing volcanic activity. Researchers propose that water-rich crustal fragments periodically sank into the mantle, contributing to magma formation.
summary.zh: 来自西澳大利亚的古老岩石表明，超过三十亿年前，水就已经深入地球内部，并影响了火山活动。研究人员提出，富含水的地壳碎片会周期性地沉入地幔，从而促进了岩浆的形成。

body.en:
Geologists studying some of Earth's oldest volcanic rocks have found evidence that water was already influencing the planet's interior and helping drive volcanic activity more than three billion years ago.

The international team, led by Adelaide University geochemist Dr. Eric Vandenburg, examined ancient rocks from Western Australia's Pilbara Craton. Their analysis suggests that water had traveled far beneath the surface before contributing to the formation of magma that fed volcanoes resembling those found around the Pacific "Ring of Fire" today.

Published in Nature Communications, the findings indicate that Earth may have been recycling water between its surface and interior much earlier than scientists had realized, even though the young planet operated very differently from the world we know now.

Dr. Vandenburg, from the School of Physics, Chemistry and Earth Sciences, said the ancient rocks offer an unusual opportunity to investigate conditions on Earth billions of years ago.

"These rocks formed more than three billion years ago, when Earth was a very different place," he said.

Today, plate tectonics plays a central role in moving water through the planet. At subduction zones, one tectonic plate sinks beneath another, carrying water from the oceans down toward the mantle. That water can help generate magma, which rises toward the surface and contributes to the volcanoes that help build continents.

"The early Earth was too hot for plates to behave that way, so until now it has been unclear whether surface water could have made that journey more than three billion years ago, and if so, how.

"What surprised us was finding evidence that large amounts of water had already made their way deep into the Earth's interior and influenced the formation of volcanic rocks."

The researchers suggest that another geological mechanism may have moved water into the mantle before modern plate tectonics became established.

They call the process "dripduction." In this scenario, dense, water-rich portions of Earth's cooler outer crust periodically sagged downward and collapsed into the hotter mantle, transporting water with them.

As those sections of crust descended, they released their water into the mantle. That water then helped generate magma, which eventually rose, erupted through volcanoes, and cooled into rocks that have survived for billions of years.

"The Earth wasn't operating exactly as it does now, but it appears some of the key processes were already in place," Dr. Vandenburg said.

The discovery addresses a major question in geology: how early did materials begin moving between Earth's surface and its deep interior?

Pinpointing when water first started traveling deep underground matters because this recycling process affects volcanic...
body.zh: 地质学家研究地球上一些最古老的火山岩发现了证据，表明水早在三十亿年前就已经影响了地球内部并帮助推动了火山活动。 由阿德莱德大学地球化学家埃里克·范登堡博士领导的国际团队检查了西澳大利亚皮尔巴拉克拉通的古代岩石。他们的分析表明，水在形成岩浆之前已经在地表下很远的地方流动，岩浆为类似于今天太平洋“火环”周围发现的火山提供了水源。 发表在《自然通讯》上的研究结果表明，地球在其表面和内部之间循环水的时间可能比科学家意识到的要早得多，尽管这颗年轻的行星的运行方式与我们现在所知的世界非常不同。 物理、化学和地球科学学院的范登堡博士说，这些古老的岩石为研究数十亿年前的地球状况提供了一个不寻常的机会。 “这些岩石形成于三十亿多年前，当时地球还是一个非常不同的地方，”他说。 如今，板块构造在地球上的水输送方面发挥着核心作用。在俯冲带，一个构造板块沉入另一个构造板块下方，将海洋中的水带到地幔中。这些水可以帮助产生岩浆，岩浆上升到地表并形成火山，从而帮助形成大陆。 “早期的地球太热，板块无法以这种方式运行，所以直到现在还不清楚地表水是否可能在三十亿年前完成这一旅程，如果是的话，又是如何完成的。 “令我们惊讶的是发现证据表明大量的水已经深入地球内部并影响了火山岩的形成。” 研究人员认为，在现代板块构造建立之前，另一种地质机制可能已将水转移到地幔中。 他们称这个过程为“滴落”。在这种情况下，地球较冷的外地壳的致密且富含水的部分会周期性地向下下垂并塌陷到较热的地幔中，并随之输送水。 当这些地壳部分下降时，它们将水释放到地幔中。这些水随后帮助产生岩浆，岩浆最终上升，通过火山喷发，并冷却成岩石，并保存了数十亿年。 范登堡博士说：“地球的运行方式与现在并不完全一样，但一些关键过程似乎已经就位。” 这一发现解决了地质学中的一个主要问题：物质多久开始在地球表面与其深层内部之间移动？ 确定水第一次开始进入地下深处的时间很重要，因为这种回收过程会影响火山...

reflection.en: The deep past of our planet continues to reveal its secrets. Geologists studying ancient rocks in Western Australia have found evidence that water played a role in volcanic activity over three billion years ago. This discovery reminds us that the Earth itself, in its very formation and ongoing processes, testifies to the intricate wisdom of its Creator.
reflection.zh: 我们星球的深层过去不断揭示其秘密。地质学家在西澳大利亚研究古老岩石时，发现了三十多亿年前水参与火山活动的证据。这一发现提醒我们，地球本身，在其形成和持续的过程中，都见证了其创造者的精妙智慧。

title.en: Scientists discover a hidden switch that shuts down inflammation
title.zh: 科学家发现关闭炎症的隐藏开关

summary.en: Scientists have identified a biological mechanism that acts as a natural 'braking system' for the immune system, helping to switch off inflammation and prevent the buildup of harmful immune cells. Boosting this pathway has shown potential in reducing inflammation-related immune changes and accelerating pain relief,...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现了一个生物机制，它能作为免疫系统的天然“刹车系统”，帮助关闭炎症并防止有害免疫细胞的积累。增强这一通路已显示出减少与炎症相关的免疫变化和加速疼痛缓解的潜力，为慢性炎症性疾病的新疗法带来了希望。

body.en:
Researchers at University College London (UCL) have identified a biological mechanism that helps the body bring inflammation to an end, a finding that could eventually lead to new treatments for chronic inflammatory diseases affecting millions of people.

Inflammation is one of the immune system's most important defense responses. It helps the body fight infection and repair damaged tissue. But if that response remains active for too long, it can begin to harm healthy tissue and contribute to conditions including arthritis, heart disease, and diabetes.

Scientists have long known a great deal about how inflammation begins. What has been less clear is how the body decides that the danger has passed and shifts from fighting a threat to repairing the damage.

The new study, published in Nature Communications, points to a group of small fat-derived molecules called epoxy-oxylipins as part of that shutdown process.

According to the researchers, these molecules act like natural brakes on the immune system. They help prevent excessive growth of intermediate monocytes,* a type of white blood cell that can support healing in the short term but may contribute to chronic inflammation if too many accumulate or remain active for too long.

To study the process directly in people, the researchers gave healthy volunteers a tiny injection of UV-killed E. coli bacteria in the forearm. Because the bacteria were no longer alive, they could not cause an infection, but they still triggered a temporary inflammatory response.

That reaction produced the familiar signs of inflammation, including pain, redness, heat, and swelling, similar to what can happen after an injury or infection.

The volunteers were divided into two groups: prophylactic arm and therapeutic arm.

Researchers then gave participants a drug called GSK2256294 at different stages of the inflammatory response. The drug blocks an enzyme known as soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH). Under normal conditions, sEH breaks down epoxy-oxylipins, so blocking the enzyme allows more of these protective molecules to remain in the body.

Blocking sEH increased epoxy-oxylipin levels, helped pain resolve more quickly, and sharply reduced the number of intermediate monocytes found in both the blood and tissue. These immune cells have been linked to persistent inflammation and the progression of inflammatory disease.

The treatment did not, however, significantly change outward signs such as redness or swelling. That suggests the drug may have been altering deeper immune processes even when visible symptoms remained largely unchanged.

They found that one epoxy-oxylipin, 12,13-EpOME, appears to suppress a protein signaling pathway known as p38 MAPK. This pathway helps drive the transformation of monocytes into the...
body.zh: 伦敦大学学院 (UCL) 的研究人员发现了一种有助于身体结束炎症的生物机制，这一发现最终可能会为影响数百万人的慢性炎症性疾病带来新的治疗方法。 炎症是免疫系统最重要的防御反应之一。它帮助身体抵抗感染并修复受损的组织。但如果这种反应持续太久，就会开始损害健康组织，并导致关节炎、心脏病和糖尿病等疾病。 长期以来，科学家们对炎症是如何发生的有了很多了解。目前尚不清楚的是，身体如何判断危险已经过去，并从对抗威胁转变为修复损伤。 这项发表在《自然通讯》上的新研究指出，一组名为环氧氧脂质的脂肪衍生小分子是该关闭过程的一部分。 研究人员表示，这些分子就像免疫系统的天然制动器一样。它们有助于防止中间单核细胞*的过度生长，这是一种白细胞，可以在短期内支持愈合，但如果过多积累或保持活跃时间过长，可能会导致慢性炎症。 为了直接在人体中研究这一过程，研究人员在健康志愿者的前臂注射了少量的紫外线杀死的大肠杆菌。由于细菌不再存活，它们无法引起感染，但仍会引发暂时的炎症反应。 这种反应产生了常见的炎症症状，包括疼痛、发红、发热和肿胀，类似于受伤或感染后可能发生的情况。 志愿者被分为两组：预防组和治疗组。 研究人员随后在炎症反应的不同阶段给参与者服用一种名为 GSK2256294 的药物。该药物阻断一种称为可溶性环氧化物水解酶（sEH）的酶。在正常情况下，sEH 会分解环氧氧脂，因此阻断该酶可以让更多的保护性分子留在体内。 阻断 sEH 会增加环氧氧脂水平，帮助疼痛更快地缓解，并大幅减少血液和组织中中间单核细胞的数量。这些免疫细胞与持续炎症和炎症性疾病的进展有关。 然而，治疗并没有显着改变外在症状，例如发红或肿胀。这表明，即使可见症状基本没有变化，该药物也可能正在改变更深层次的免疫过程。 他们发现一种环氧氧脂，12,13-EpOME，似乎可以抑制称为 p38 MAPK 的蛋白质信号传导途径。该途径有助于驱动单核细胞转化为...

reflection.en: The marvel of creation continues to reveal its intricate wisdom. Scientists at University College London have uncovered a natural mechanism that regulates inflammation, demonstrating how the physical world, when observed with diligence, offers profound insights. This discovery reminds us that the principles of healing and balance are woven into the fabric...
reflection.zh: 造物的奇妙继续揭示其精妙的智慧。伦敦大学学院的科学家们发现了一种调节炎症的天然机制，这表明当我们勤奋观察时，物质世界能提供深刻的见解。这一发现提醒我们，治愈与平衡的原则编织在存在的结构中，等待被理解。

title.en: AI could make holiday planning easier for overwhelmed travelers
title.zh: 人工智能可以使旅行计划对不堪重负的旅行者更加轻松

summary.en: New research from the University of Surrey suggests that generative AI can help overwhelmed travelers organize their thoughts, compare options, and complete vacation plans that they might otherwise abandon. The study, published in the Journal of Travel Research, presents a framework based on interviews with UK adults...
summary.zh: 萨里大学的最新研究表明，生成式人工智能可以帮助不堪重负的旅行者整理思绪、比较选项并完成他们可能因此放弃的度假计划。这项发表在《旅游研究杂志》上的研究提出了一个概念框架，该框架基于对使用生成式人工智能规划实际或近期行程的英国成年人的访谈，并说明了人工智能如何通过承担部分协调工作来充当“认知支架”。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Generative AI could help overwhelmed travelers organize their thoughts, compare options and complete vacation plans they might otherwise abandon, according to new research from the University of Surrey.

The study, published in Journal of Travel Research , presents a conceptual framework based on interviews with a group of U.K. adults who had used generative AI to help plan a real or recent trip. The framework shows how AI can act as a form of " cognitive scaffolding ," taking on part of the coordination work while travelers remain in control of their decisions.

The benefits were particularly apparent among travelers who found planning harder to manage. For some, AI turned vacation planning from a task they might delay or give up on into something they felt able to complete.

Dr. Yoonjung Kim, a doctoral researcher in hospitality and tourism management at the University of Surrey and lead author of the study, said, "Planning a vacation involves a series of connected decisions about transport, accommodation, budgets and activities. This can quickly become overwhelming, particularly when travelers are faced with endless information and choices."

"Our research finds that generative AI can provide structure, help people stay focused and make it easier to move forward without taking the final decision out of their hands."

The researchers describe this as a redistribution of mental work rather than its removal. The technology can organize information and keep track of details, freeing travelers to focus their attention on comparing options and making judgments.

Professor Iis Tussyadiah, dean of Surrey Business School and coauthor of the study, said, "For some travelers, generative AI is more than a convenient shortcut. It can make a demanding decision-making process feel manageable and, in some cases, make planning feel possible."

"These findings show how travel technology could become more inclusive by being designed around the different ways people think, plan and make decisions."

The findings point to the potential for more cognitively inclusive travel technology that better accommodates diverse ways of thinking and planning, including support for neurodivergent travelers. The researchers emphasize, however, that the cognitive demands of travel planning can affect any traveler, particularly when a trip involves large amounts of information, multiple constraints and interconnected decisions.

Dr. Bora Kim, associate professor in Surrey Hospitality and Tourism Management and coauthor of the study, said, "The real promise of AI in travel planning is not simply speed or...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 萨里大学的最新研究表明，生成式人工智能可以帮助不知所措的旅行者组织他们的想法，比较选择并完成他们可能会放弃的假期计划。 这项发表在《旅行研究杂志》上的研究提出了一个概念框架，该框架基于对一群使用生成人工智能来帮助计划真实或最近旅行的英国成年人的采访。该框架展示了人工智能如何充当“认知脚手架”的一种形式，承担部分协调工作，同时旅行者仍然控制自己的决定。 对于那些发现计划更难管理的旅行者来说，这种好处尤其明显。对于一些人来说，人工智能将假期计划从他们可能会推迟或放弃的任务变成了他们认为能够完成的任务。 萨里大学酒店和旅游管理博士研究员、该研究的主要作者 Yoonjung Kim 博士表示：“计划假期涉及到一系列有关交通、住宿、预算和活动的相互关联的决策。这很快就会变得令人不知所措，特别是当旅行者面临无穷无尽的信息和选择时。” “我们的研究发现，生成式人工智能可以提供结构，帮助人们保持专注，让他们更容易前进，而无需将最终决定权从他们手中夺走。” 研究人员将其描述为脑力工作的重新分配，而不是消除。该技术可以组织信息并跟踪细节，使旅行者能够将注意力集中在比较选项和做出判断上。 萨里商学院院长、该研究的合著者 Iis Tussyadiah 教授表示：“对于一些旅行者来说，生成式人工智能不仅仅是一条便捷的捷径。它可以让要求严格的决策过程变得易于管理，在某些情况下，让计划变得可能。” “这些发现表明，通过围绕人们思考、计划和决策的不同方式进行设计，旅行技术可以变得更具包容性。” 研究结果表明，旅行技术具有更具认知包容性的潜力，可以更好地适应不同的思维和规划方式，包括为神经分歧的旅行者提供支持。然而，研究人员强调，旅行计划的认知需求可能会影响任何旅行者，特别是当旅行涉及大量信息、多重约束和相互关联的决策时。 萨里酒店和旅游管理学院副教授、该研究的合著者 Bora Kim 博士表示：“人工智能在旅行规划中的真正前景不仅仅是速度或......

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge and the desire to understand the world around us are deeply ingrained in the human spirit. As we develop new tools like generative AI, they can serve as valuable aids in navigating complex tasks, such as planning a much-needed vacation. This technology, when used wisely, can help alleviate the burden of decision-making and allow us...
reflection.zh: 对知识的追求和理解周围世界的渴望深深植根于人类的精神之中。当我们开发出生成式人工智能等新工具时，它们可以成为我们处理复杂任务（如规划一次急需的假期）的宝贵助手。这项技术如果使用得当，可以帮助减轻决策的负担，让我们更好地组织生活和实现愿望。

title.en: Five night sky events to look out for this autumn
title.zh: 今秋不容错过的五个夜空奇观

summary.en: From meteor showers to a November supermoon, there are a number of impressive sights to behold in the autumn night sky.
summary.zh: 从流星雨到十一月的超级月亮，秋季夜空中将有许多令人印象深刻的景象。

body.en:
Autumn brings longer nights to the northern hemisphere, offering more opportunities to get outside and look up at the night sky.

There is plenty to look out for over the coming months, from impressive meteor showers to dazzling star clusters.

It will be followed by the impressive Orionid meteor shower in late October, and a planetary parade, the Leonid meteor shower and a supermoon in November.

As the nights lengthen through autumn, one of the most recognisable star clusters in the night sky becomes increasingly prominent.

The Pleiades, also known as the Seven Sisters, is a cluster of young stars around 440 light years from Earth.

Despite its name, most people can see around six stars with the naked eye, although many more become visible through binoculars or a telescope.

Look towards the east during autumn evenings, where the Pleiades can be found in the constellation Taurus.

The Orionid meteor shower is active from early October into November, reaching its peak around 21 October.

Twice each year, Earth passes through trails of dust and debris left behind by Halley's comet. As these tiny particles enter Earth's atmosphere at high speed, they heat up and produce the streaks of light we see as meteors.

The Orionids appear to radiate from the constellation Orion, which gives the shower its name.

For the best chance of seeing them, find somewhere dark and away from artificial lights and allow your eyes time to adjust.

Early risers could be treated to a gathering of Mercury, Venus, Mars and Jupiter around 14 November.

All four planets will be above the horizon before sunrise, although some will be easier to spot than others.

Mercury will be particularly challenging because it remains low in the sky and close to the glare of the rising sun.

Venus and Jupiter, meanwhile, are among the brightest objects in our night sky and should be much easier to pick out.

Another meteor shower arrives later in November, with the Leonids expected to peak around 17 November.

The Leonids can travel at about 70km per second as they enter the Earth's atmosphere, making them some of the fastest meteors visible from Earth.

Under ideal, dark sky conditions, around 10 to 15 Leonids an hour can be visible at the shower's peak, although the actual number seen will depend on weather, light pollution and the brightness of the Moon.

They get their name from the constellation Leo, from which the meteors appear to radiate.

The best time to look is generally after midnight and before dawn, when Leo is higher in the sky.

November's full moon is known as the Beaver Moon. The name is thought to come from the time of year when beavers were particularly active, preparing their lodges and storing food ahead of winter.

A supermoon occurs when a full Moon is relatively...
body.zh: 秋天给北半球带来了更长的夜晚，提供了更多外出仰望夜空的机会。 在接下来的几个月里，从令人印象深刻的流星雨到令人眼花缭乱的星团，有很多值得关注的事情。 随后，十月下旬将迎来令人印象深刻的猎户座流星雨，十一月将举行行星巡游、狮子座流星雨和超级月亮。 随着秋季夜晚的延长，夜空中最容易辨认的星团之一变得越来越突出。 昴宿星团，也称为七姐妹星团，是距离地球约 440 光年的年轻恒星团。 尽管它的名字如此，大多数人都可以用肉眼看到大约六颗恒星，尽管通过双筒望远镜或望远镜可以看到更多的恒星。 秋天的夜晚向东方看，可以在金牛座找到昴宿星团。 猎户座流星雨从10月初到11月都很活跃，在10月21日左右达到顶峰。 地球每年两次穿过哈雷彗星留下的尘埃和碎片痕迹。当这些微小粒子高速进入地球大气层时，它们会升温并产生我们所看到的流星光条纹。 猎户座流星雨似乎是从猎户座辐射出来的，猎户座流星雨因此得名。 为了最好地看到它们，请找到一个黑暗且远离人造光源的地方，让您的眼睛有时间进行调整。 早起的人可能会在 11 月 14 日左右看到水星、金星、火星和木星的聚集。 所有四颗行星都将在日出前出现在地平线以上，尽管有些行星比其他行星更容易被发现。 水星将特别具有挑战性，因为它仍然在天空中很低并且靠近初升太阳的耀眼光芒。 与此同时，金星和木星是夜空中最亮的天体之一，应该更容易辨认出来。 另一场流星雨将于 11 月晚些时候到来，预计狮子座流星雨将在 11 月 17 日左右达到峰值。 狮子座流星雨进入地球大气层时的速度约为每秒 70 公里，使其成为从地球上可见的速度最快的流星之一。 在理想的黑暗天空条件下，在流星雨高峰期每小时可以看到大约 10 到 15 个狮子座流星雨，不过实际看到的数量将取决于天气、光污染和月球的亮度。 它们的名字来源于狮子座，流星似乎是从狮子座辐射出来的。 最佳观测时间通常是午夜之后和黎明之前，此时狮子座在天空中较高的位置。 十一月的满月被称为海狸月。这个名字被认为来自一年中海狸特别活跃的时期，它们在冬天之前准备它们的小屋并储存食物。 当满月相对......时就会发生超级月亮。

reflection.en: As the nights grow longer this autumn, the sky offers a spectacular display of celestial events, from the dazzling Pleiades star cluster to meteor showers and a supermoon. These sights remind us of the vastness and beauty of creation, a silent testament to the glory of its Maker. May these cosmic wonders inspire awe and reflection, drawing our hearts to...
reflection.zh: 随着今秋夜幕渐长，天空将呈现出壮观的天体景象，从耀眼的昴星团到流星雨和超级月亮。这些景象提醒我们造物的浩瀚与美丽，是其创造者荣耀的无声见证。 愿这些宇宙奇观激发敬畏与沉思，引领我们的心去思索那位 orchestrates 天空并呼召我们仰望惊叹的造物主。

verse.textEn: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
verse.textZh: 诸天述说神的荣耀，穹苍传扬他的手段。

title.en: Magnetic nanoparticles detect amoxicillin allergy with 98% sensitivity in early tests
title.zh: 磁性纳米颗粒在早期测试中以 98% 的敏感性检测青霉素过敏

summary.en: A multidisciplinary scientific team at the University of Malaga has developed a new technology based on magnetic nanoparticles that enables precise, rapid and reliable diagnosis of allergy to beta-lactam antibiotics, including amoxicillin and other penicillins.
summary.zh: 马拉加大学的一个多学科科学团队开发了一种基于磁性纳米颗粒的新技术，能够精确、快速、可靠地诊断对 β-内酰胺类抗生素（包括阿莫西林和其他青霉素）的过敏。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A multidisciplinary scientific team at the University of Malaga has developed a new technology based on magnetic nanoparticles that enables precise, rapid and reliable diagnosis of allergy to beta-lactam antibiotics, including amoxicillin and other penicillins.

This is a "highly efficient" in vitro diagnostic platform based on 30 nm nanoparticles with an iron oxide core and silica shell, which act "like a tiny magnet covered with thousands of molecular hooks." "If the patient's blood contains the IgE antibodies responsible for the allergy, they are captured much more readily than with conventional methods," explains Ezequiel Pérez-Inestrosa, professor of organic chemistry at the University of Malaga and one of the study's authors.

The journal Materials Today Bio reported the findings of the study, which also involved researchers from the IBIMA BIONAD Platform, the Inflammatory Diseases Network (REI) and the Regional University Hospital of Malaga. Yolanda Vida and María I. Montañez, researchers in the University of Malaga's Department of Organic Chemistry, are the study's lead authors.

"In the tests performed, the system was able to detect virtually all true cases of allergy and reduced both false negatives and false positives," says María José Torres, professor of medicine and another researcher leading the study.

In this regard, Torres notes that penicillin allergy is overdiagnosed. "Although between 8% and 25% of the population report being allergic to these antibiotics, only between 1% and 10% actually are. This incorrect label leads to the use of alternative drugs that are generally less effective, more toxic and contribute to the emergence of bacterial resistance," Pérez-Inestrosa explains. He stresses the importance of identifying these cases safely, as this would make it possible to remove thousands of incorrect diagnoses that affect patients' treatment.

In addition, this new method avoids drug provocation tests with the medication itself, which carry risks for patients, because the analysis can be performed much more simply and rapidly in the laboratory, without lengthy centrifugation procedures.

For this study, blood samples from nearly 100 people were analyzed—50 patients with confirmed amoxicillin allergy and 44 individuals who tolerated these antibiotics. The new technology was also compared with two techniques: ImmunoCAP, the most widely used commercial test, and conventional RAST. Specifically for amoxicillin, the platform achieved 98% sensitivity, whereas ImmunoCAP detected only around 17%.

Montañez 是该研究的主要作者。 “在进行的测试中，该系统能够检测出几乎所有真实的过敏病例，并减少了假阴性和假阳性，”医学教授、另一位领导这项研究的研究员玛丽亚·何塞·托雷斯 (María José Torres) 说。 在这方面，托雷斯指出，青霉素过敏被过度诊断了。 “虽然 8% 到 25% 的人口报告对这些抗生素过敏，但实际上只有 1% 到 10% 的人过敏。这种不正确的标签导致使用替代药物，这些药物通常效果较差、毒性更大，并会导致细菌耐药性的出现，”Pérez-Inestrosa 解释道。他强调安全识别这些病例的重要性，因为这将能够消除数以千计影响患者治疗的错误诊断。 此外，这种新方法避免了对药物本身进行药物激发试验，这会给患者带来风险，因为分析可以在实验室中更简单、更快速地进行，无需冗长的离心程序。 在这项研究中，分析了近 100 人的血液样本，其中 50 名患者确诊对阿莫西林过敏，44 名患者对这些抗生素耐受。该新技术还与两种技术进行了比较：ImmunoCAP（最广泛使用的商业测试）和传统的 RAST。特别是对于阿莫西林，该平台实现了 98% 的灵敏度，而ImmunoCAP 仅检测到 17% 左右。 鉴于这一发现，作者强调需要......

This team's innovation, born from observing and manipulating the physical world, offers a precise diagnostic tool. It reminds us that wisdom and insight can be found when we diligently study the world around us, reflecting the Creator's...
