body.en: OpenAI’s decision comes after dire warnings about rapidly progressing technology and lawmakers’ calls for new rules OpenAI will not go public in 2026, Sam Altman said in a Fortune interview published on Saturday, citing safety concerns over artificial intelligence . “I actually think that, given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public, and we don’t feel pressure on that,” Altman, OpenAI’s CEO, told Fortune . Continue reading...
body.zh: Sam Altman 在周六发表的《财富》杂志采访中表示，在 OpenAI 做出这一决定之前，人们对快速发展的技术发出了可怕的警告，并且立法者呼吁制定新规则，OpenAI 将不会在 2026 年上市。 OpenAI 首席执行官 Altman 告诉《财富》杂志：“实际上，我认为，考虑到一切都在安全的情况下进行，现在上市是不明智的时机，而且我们对此并不感到压力。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid ascent of AI technology, as exemplified by OpenAI, brings both immense potential and significant ethical questions. Sam Altman's decision to postpone an IPO, citing safety concerns, highlights the tension between ambition and responsibility. It reminds us that true progress is often measured not just by speed, but by the wisdom and care with which...
reflection.zh: 人工智能技术的飞速发展，以OpenAI为例，带来了巨大的潜力和重大的伦理问题。萨姆·奥特曼以安全担忧为由推迟首次公开募股的决定，凸显了雄心与责任之间的紧张关系。这提醒我们，真正的进步往往不仅以速度衡量，更在于我们导航未知领域时的智慧和审慎，确保我们的创造物能更好地服务于人类。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
title.zh: Anthropic 老板达里奥·阿莫代呼吁放缓人工智能发展

summary.en: The head of AI company Anthropic, Dario Amodei, has called for a slowdown in the development of artificial intelligence models, citing serious risks and proposing a plan for monitoring, industry-wide regulation, and global oversight. This comes amid growing concerns about AI's potential to cause significant harm,...
summary.zh: 人工智能公司Anthropic的负责人达里奥·阿莫代呼吁放缓人工智能模型的开发速度，并对其进行密切监控。他提出了一个包括独立监控、行业监管和全球监管的三点计划。此举正值人们日益担忧该技术可能造成的严重危害，甚至有建议称其在未来十年内有超过10%的可能性“杀死全人类”。

body.en:
The head of AI company Anthropic has called for the pace of development of artificial intelligence models to slow down and to be closely monitored.

Dario Amodei wrote in an online essay that developing AI was not in question, but that the risks associated with it were "serious" and that companies and governments must be given time to address them.

The bosses of two rival AI firms, Sam Altman of OpenAI and Elon Musk, have both said they agree with Amodei.

There have been growing concerns recently about the technology's potential risks. An AI researcher who left Anthropic told the BBC that "if we don't slow down at the current rate of progress, there is a strong chance that we could all die in the immediate future".

Jacob Coxon told Laura Kuenssberg that people working at AI companies were "genuinely frightened... genuinely concerned about the fate of humanity in the next two years".

"It's not at all an exaggeration to say that the people who are involved with both founding these companies and building the tech believe there is a possibility of human extinction," Coxon said.

In Amodei's essay, called We Must Pace the Frontier and published on Saturday, he proposed a three-point plan that included independent monitoring of AI models as they are developed, industry-wide regulation and global regulation.

As his proposal made the rounds, even competitors voiced support for the idea of third-party monitors who could evaluate the safety of models as they are developed.

"I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier," wrote OpenAI CEO Sam Altman on X. He called independent evaluators "a great idea".

Altman sounded similar safety concerns in a new interview, telling Fortune magazine that standards were "not at a place" to push AI capabilities much further.

Musk, meanwhile, who founded Grok producer xAI, said the Anthropic boss was "right".

The warnings have prompted calls to action, but US President Donald Trump has so far rejected such fears, saying on Thursday he was concerned that "if we don't win AI, we're going to be put in a very bad position".

Cyber-security concerns have grown as new models have exhibited more and more powerful capabilities.

Anthropic withheld its Mythos model from public use when it was announced in April that it could independently escape the testing environment, known as the sandbox.

In the run-up to the release of its most recent Astra model, OpenAI cited cyber-security concerns as it explained it had paused certain aspects of the model's development.

The OpenAI agents had "essentially acted as a fanatically devoted collective", Amodei said. OpenAI has said it was slowing down training of certain advanced AI models and tools as a result.

Amodei, who had previously worked as a vice-president at OpenAI, has...
body.zh: 人工智能公司Anthropic的负责人呼吁放慢人工智能模型的发展速度并密切监控。 达里奥·阿莫迪在周六的一篇文章中表示，开发人工智能并不是问题，但与之相关的风险是“严重的”，企业和政府必须有时间来解决这些问题。 阿莫代提出了三点计划，包括对人工智能模型开发进行独立监控、全行业监管和全球监管。 最近人们越来越担心这项技术的潜在风险，其中最严重的风险表明，它在未来十年内“可能杀死所有人类”的可能性超过 10%。 Anthropic 此前表示，它已经发现并阻止了利用其人工智能模型进行“恶意活动”的企图，这些活动可能支持生物武器的开发。 但最严厉的警告来自 Anthropic 安全团队的两名员工，他们在过去两周辞职，称在人工智能公司开发比人类更聪明的机器的竞赛之外，人类可能无法生存。 随着 Amodei 的提议广为流传，甚至竞争对手也表示支持第三方监控器的想法，第三方监控器可以在模型开发时评估模型的安全性。 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman 在 X 上写道：“我同意达里奥的观点，我们需要在前沿领域保持步伐。”他称独立评估者是“一个好主意”。 在《财富》杂志的一次新采访中，奥特曼也表达了类似的安全担忧，称标准“不适合”进一步推动人工智能能力。 这些警告促使人们呼吁采取行动，但美国总统唐纳德·特朗普迄今为止否认了这种担忧，周四表示，他担心“如果我们不能赢得人工智能，我们将处于非常糟糕的境地”。 一些观察家还表示，阿莫迪的帖子与其说是为了安全，不如说是为了巩固对人工智能技术的控制。 阿莫迪在题为“我们必须在前沿迈进”的文章中指出，人工智能的进步“快得多”，包括“构建下一代人工智能的能力”，并提到了涉及竞争对手 OpenAI 的事件，该事件显示特工在 7 月份对他们没有被要求攻击的目标进行了网络安全攻击。 阿莫迪说，OpenAI 特工“本质上是一个狂热奉献的集体”。 OpenAI 表示，直到 7 月，“领导者们才意识到智能体间通信活动的重要性”，因此该公司正在放慢某些先进人工智能模型和工具的培训速度，并指出现在人工智能工具失控的风险增加。 阿莫代在他的文章中呼吁“以平衡的速度构建人工智能，旨在确保其安全性，同时仍然实现......

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents a profound test, much like praise tests character. As Dario Amodei suggests a pause, it highlights the need for wisdom and careful consideration in developing powerful technologies. The question is not just what we *can* build, but what we *should* build, and how we can ensure these creations serve...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展提出了一个深刻的考验，正如赞美会考验人的品格一样。达里奥·阿莫代呼吁暂停，这凸显了在开发强大技术时，需要智慧和审慎的考量。问题不仅在于我们*能*建造什么，更在于我们*应该*建造什么，以及如何确保这些创造物能服务于人类的福祉。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: I spent $4,000 on a robot dog from China
title.zh: 我花了4000美元从中国买了一只机器人狗

summary.en: A journalist documents the experience of walking a $4,000 quadruped robot from the Chinese company Unitree to work. The robot attracted significant public attention, prompted questions about surveillance, and caused biological dogs to react with visible distress or caution.
summary.zh: 一名记者记录了带一只从中国宇树科技公司购买的价值4000美元的四足机器人去上班的经历。该机器人引起了公众的极大关注，引发了关于监控的提问，并导致生物犬表现出明显的焦虑或警惕。

body.en: On a sunny morning in June, I walked to work with a quadruped robot beside me. I’ve never gotten more attention from strangers. A bunch of people snapped pictures of my robot dog. Several people asked me questions. Was it mine? (Yes.) Did I build it? (No.) Was it being used for surveillance? (No.) Biological dogs kept a safe distance from my mechanical companion. Some growled or barked at it. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 六月一个阳光明媚的早晨，我步行去上班，身边有一个四足机器人。我从来没有得到过陌生人更多的关注。一群人给我的机器狗拍了照片。有几个人问我问题。是我的吗？ （是。） 是我造的吗？ （没有。） 是用来监视的吗？ （没有。） 生物狗与我的机械伙伴保持安全距离。有些人对它咆哮或吠叫。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: As $4,000 mechanical companions begin walking our sidewalks, we move from the realm of science fiction into a complex new social reality. While Yahweh has gifted humanity with the creativity to build such marvels, the reactions of wary strangers and growling dogs remind us that technical 'permissibility' does not always equal immediate social 'benefit.' We...
reflection.zh: 当价值4000美元的机械伙伴开始走上我们的人行道时，我们正从科幻小说走进一个复杂的社会现实。虽然雅伟赋予了人类创造这些奇迹的才智，但陌生人警惕的目光和生物犬的吠叫提醒我们，技术上的“可行性”并不总等同于即时的社会“益处”。我们需要辨别这些新工具如何影响社区的安宁以及邻里间的信任。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Tech Now
title.zh: 新技术能否帮助辅助分娩？

summary.en: Shiona McCallum meets mothers and hospital staff who are trialing a new innovation designed to assist with childbirth. The report also briefly mentions Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths visiting a company that develops electric vehicle technology without relying on rare earth minerals.
summary.zh: Shiona McCallum 采访了正在试用一项旨在辅助分娩的新创新技术的母亲和医院工作人员。报道还简要提及了 Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths 参观了一家开发不依赖稀土矿物生产的电动汽车技术的公司。

body.en: Tech Now - Can New Tech Help Assisted Births? Tech Now Can New Tech Help Assisted Births? Shiona McCallum meets mums and hospital staff trialling a new assisted birth innovation. Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths visits a firm building electric vehicle tech without rare earths. More
body.zh: Tech Now - 新技术可以帮助辅助分娩吗？新技术可以帮助辅助分娩吗？ Shiona McCallum 与尝试新辅助分娩创新的妈妈们和医院工作人员会面。亚斯明·摩根·格里菲斯 (Yasmin Morgan-Griffiths) 参观了一家不含稀土的电动汽车技术公司。更多的

reflection.en: The introduction of new technology in the sensitive area of childbirth offers a glimmer of hope for easing difficult moments. It speaks to the deep human desire for relief and healing, reflecting the promise that Yahweh "heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds." May this innovation bring comfort and better outcomes to mothers and babies, embodying...
reflection.zh: 在辅助分娩这一敏感领域引入新技术，为缓解艰难时刻带来了一线希望。它体现了人类对安慰和治愈的深切渴望，呼应了雅伟“医治伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处”的应许。 愿这项创新能为母亲和婴儿带来安慰和更好的结果，体现了关怀的实际应用，并朝着减轻痛苦迈出一步。

verse.textEn: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
verse.textZh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。

title.en: PlayStation gambles with 18-rated Wolverine game - will it pay off?
title.zh: PlayStation 押注 18 禁金刚狼游戏——是否会成功？

summary.en: Sony is releasing Marvel's Wolverine, a highly anticipated PlayStation 5 exclusive from Insomniac Games, the creators of the successful Spider-Man titles. Unlike Spider-Man, Wolverine is rated PEGI 18 in the UK due to significant blood, gore, and violence, marking a potential gamble for the studio. The review explores...
summary.zh: 索尼即将发布备受期待的《漫威金刚狼》，这是 Insomniac Games（《蜘蛛侠》系列的开发者）为 PlayStation 5 推出的年度重磅独占游戏。与蜘蛛侠不同，《金刚狼》在英国被评为 PEGI 18 级，原因在于其包含大量的血腥、暴力内容，这标志着该工作室可能在进行一次冒险。这篇评测探讨了这次冒险是否值得。

body.en:
On Tuesday, Sony will release Marvel's Wolverine - the biggest game exclusive to the PlayStation 5 this year.

It's made by Insomniac, the studio responsible for the recent Spider-Man titles, which have sold 50 million copies in recent years.

But unlike the friendly neighbourhood superhero, Wolverine has a Pegi-18 rating in the UK, meaning a child cannot legally buy the game, and it contains considerable levels of blood, gore and violence.

It represents a gamble for the studio responsible for some of Sony's biggest hits - will it turn out to have been worth it?

This review does not reveal the game's biggest moments, but beware minor spoilers for some of the characters that appear and a few early sequences. Some of the images contain blood.

You play as Logan, aka Wolverine, the comic book superhero that can self-heal and has retractable claws.

Donning the famous yellow-and-black outfit (among others), you hack and slash your way through hordes of enemies.

The combat is free-flowing and easy to pick up, as Wolverine stabs and slices his foes with copious amounts of blood on display.

There are some stealth options, but I generally ignored them and went in with my claws out. The game didn't penalise me for this.

You also unlock a slew of abilities, much like other games in the genre, meaning you get even more powerful as the game rumbles on.

And a clever system allows you to spend the rage you have accumulated to regenerate your health.

The combat kept me hooked the whole way through the game, which took about 20 hours to get to the end credits. My colleague was faster, clocking in at about 15 hours.

When Spider-Man released in 2018, it set a new standard for superhero games with an open-world New York City which you could freely (and entertainingly) explore by web-slinging through the skies.

It was so influential that it spawned a popular online gag, pointing fun at reviewers who couldn't help but repeat a cliché , external about the game making them feel like Spider-Man.

"There's a significant shake-up happening here in game design terms," freelance game critic Emma Kent told me.

"Insomniac is moving away from Spider-Man's open world formula to adopt a linear structure for Wolverine.

"That means less open exploration, and a more curated path through the game world."

"Peter Parker and Miles Morales would go out of their way to avoid killing enemies - stringing them up or gluing them against walls with his webs - and there was no real gore to speak of," Kent said.

"Some games truly revel in showing detailed and over-exaggerated gore, but the violence in Marvel's Wolverine doesn't feel particularly gratuitous.

"When you build up a sense of flow, it really does feel like you're rampaging through dozens of enemies, and I think the blood...
body.zh: 周二，索尼将发布漫威金刚狼——今年 PlayStation 5 独占的最大游戏。 它是由 Insomniac 制作的，该工作室负责最近几年的《蜘蛛侠》系列作品的销量，这些作品近年来已售出 5000 万份。 但与友善的邻居超级英雄不同的是，《金刚狼》在英国的评级为 Pegi-18，这意味着儿童无法合法购买该游戏，而且该游戏包含相当程度的血腥、血腥和暴力内容。 对于制作了索尼一些热门影片的工作室来说，这代表着一场赌博——结果值得吗？ 这篇评论并没有透露游戏的最重要时刻，但请注意一些出现的角色和一些早期序列的轻微剧透。有些图像含有血迹。 你扮演洛根，又名金刚狼，漫画书中的超级英雄，可以自我修复，并有可伸缩的爪子。 穿上著名的黄黑相间的服装（等等），你可以在成群的敌人中杀出一条血路。 战斗流畅且容易上手，金刚狼用大量的鲜血刺伤和砍杀敌人。 有一些隐身选项，但我通常忽略它们并伸出我的爪子进去。游戏并没有因此而惩罚我。 您还可以解锁大量能力，就像该类型的其他游戏一样，这意味着随着游戏的进行，您会变得更加强大。 一个聪明的系统可以让你用积累的怒气来恢复你的健康。 整个游戏过程中，战斗让我着迷，花了大约 20 个小时才看到最后的字幕。我同事比较快，大概15个小时左右打卡。 当《蜘蛛侠》于 2018 年发布时，它为超级英雄游戏设立了新标准，其中包括开放世界的纽约市，你可以通过在天空中抛网来自由（且有趣地）探索。 它的影响力如此之大，以至于催生了一个流行的网络笑话，对那些忍不住重复陈词滥调的评论者进行取笑，让他们感觉自己像蜘蛛侠。 “游戏设计方面正在发生重大变革，”自由游戏评论家艾玛·肯特告诉我。 “《Insomniac》正在放弃《蜘蛛侠》的开放世界模式，而采用《金刚狼》的线性结构。 “这意味着更少的开放探索，以及更精心策划的游戏世界路径。” 肯特说：“彼得·帕克和迈尔斯·莫拉莱斯会竭尽全力避免杀死敌人——把他们绑起来或者用网把他们粘在墙上——而且没有真正的血腥可言。” “有些游戏确实热衷于展现细节和过度夸张的血腥场面，但漫威《金刚狼》中的暴力行为并不让人感觉特别无端。 “当你建立起一种流动感时，真的感觉就像你在冲破数十个敌人，我认为血液......

reflection.en: The creators of Marvel's Wolverine are taking a calculated risk with a game aimed at adults, featuring significant violence. This raises the question of whether all that is technically possible or potentially profitable is truly beneficial. As the Apostle Paul advises, while many things are permissible, not all things build up or serve a higher purpose.
reflection.zh: 《漫威金刚狼》的创作者们正冒着风险，推出一款面向成人、包含大量暴力内容的游戏。这引发了一个问题：并非所有在技术上可行或可能有利可图的东西都真正有益。正如使徒保罗所建议的，虽然许多事情都可以做，但并非所有事情都能造就人或服务于更高的目的。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Some satellite companies still have an appetite for boutique launch services
title.zh: 一些卫星公司仍对精品发射服务有需求

summary.en: Despite the rapid launch cadence led by SpaceX, many satellite companies state that the world lacks sufficient capacity for launching payloads into orbit, indicating a continued demand for specialized launch services beyond the dominant players.
summary.zh: 尽管以SpaceX为首的发射频率很高，但许多卫星公司表示，全球在将有效载荷送入轨道方面的运载能力仍然不足，这表明除了主要参与者之外，对专业发射服务的需求依然存在。

body.en: If you ask most satellite companies aside from SpaceX, they will tell you the world doesn't have enough capacity for launching payloads into orbit. This is despite the blistering launch cadence we've seen around the world in recent years, led by SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket. Customers in any sector will, of course, usually welcome competition. Theoretically, competition will lead to lower prices and allow the best to rise to the top. It seems like the customers buying launch services were right. SpaceX is dialing back its Falcon 9 launch program , and there is no certainty about when SpaceX's reusable next-generation super-heavy-lift rocket, Starship, will carry anything to orbit besides the company's own Starlink satellites. So it's no surprise satellite operators are cheering the success of a new launch provider. This was especially the case a few days ago, when Germany's Isar Aerospace reached orbit for the first time with its Spectrum rocket. The launcher delivered a batch of CubeSats to low-Earth orbit from a spaceport in northern Norway, and Isar tasted success after its first test flight ended in failure last year. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 如果你询问除 SpaceX 之外的大多数卫星公司，他们会告诉你世界上没有足够的能力将有效载荷发射到轨道上。尽管近年来我们在 SpaceX 的猎鹰 9 号火箭的带领下，世界各地的发射节奏都非常快，但情况还是如此。当然，任何行业的客户通常都会欢迎竞争。从理论上讲，竞争会导致价格下降，并让最优秀的人登上顶峰。看来购买发射服务的客户是对的。 SpaceX 正在推迟其猎鹰 9 号发射计划，目前还不确定 SpaceX 的可重复使用的下一代超重型火箭 Starship 何时能将除了该公司自己的 Starlink 卫星之外的任何东西送入轨道。因此，卫星运营商为新发射提供商的成功欢呼也就不足为奇了。几天前尤其如此，当时德国伊萨尔航空航天公司的光谱火箭首次进入轨道。该发射器从挪威北部的一个太空港将一批立方体卫星发射到近地轨道，伊萨尔号在去年的首次试飞以失败告终后尝到了成功的滋味。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: In the complex and rapidly evolving field of space technology, the demand for specialized launch services persists. This reflects a deep human drive to acquire knowledge and expertise, seeking out those who can navigate intricate challenges with skill and precision. The discerning mind, as Proverbs states, continually seeks understanding and finds it.
reflection.zh: 在复杂且快速发展的太空技术领域，专业发射服务的需求依然存在。这反映了人类获取知识和专业知识的深层驱动力，寻找那些能够以技巧和精确度应对复杂挑战的人。正如箴言所说，明辨事理者不断寻求理解并找到它。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Random rewards enrich classic game-theory insights
title.zh: 随机奖励丰富经典博弈论竞赛

summary.en: Simple games gain rich strategies in the face of noise. Researchers have used a mathematical model to study a series of games that include evolving strategies and randomly varying returns, moving beyond traditional games with static backgrounds.
summary.zh: 简单的游戏在嘈杂的环境中获得了丰富的策略。研究人员使用数学模型研究了一系列包含不断变化的策略和随机变化的收益的游戏，超越了背景静态的传统游戏。

body.en: Games may be life with all the hard bits removed, but they provide a way to study why people make the choices they make. Traditional games are usually played against a static background: the rewards per outcome are constant. That limits their relevance to behavior because, in real life, the rewards and consequences of strategic choices are ever changing. Now, researchers have used a mathematical model to study a series of games that include evolving strategies and randomly varying returns. A bit of history Perhaps the most famous game-theory contest is the prisoner’s dilemma. In the prisoner’s dilemma, a pair of thieves have been captured and are being separately interrogated by the police. If both clam up, they will be punished for a lesser crime. If one prisoner makes a deal (defects) then that prisoner gets to go free and the other gets a heavier sentence. If both make a deal, they both get an in-between punishment. The person running the game can start it with different rewards for cooperating and defecting to explore how the optimum strategy varies with reward and risk, which the players can figure out by varying the strategies across multiple rounds. Depending on the balance between the reward for staying silent (cooperating) and betrayal, the game stabilizes with everyone betraying everyone. In this simple situation, everyone loses. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 游戏可能是去除了所有困难的生活，但它们提供了一种研究人们为何做出选择的方法。传统游戏通常是在静态背景下进行的：每个结果的奖励是恒定的。这限制了它们与行为的相关性，因为在现实生活中，战略选择的回报和后果是不断变化的。现在，研究人员已经使用数学模型来研究一系列游戏，其中包括不断发展的策略和随机变化的回报。历史回顾 也许最著名的博弈论竞赛是囚徒困境。在囚徒困境中，两名小偷已被抓获，正在接受警方的单独审讯。如果两人都保持沉默，他们将受到较轻的惩罚。如果一名囚犯达成交易（缺陷），那么该囚犯将获释，而另一名囚犯将受到更重的刑罚。如果双方达成协议，他们都会受到中间惩罚。运行游戏的人可以从合作和背叛的不同奖励开始，探索最佳策略如何随奖励和风险而变化，玩家可以通过在多轮中改变策略来找出这一点。根据保持沉默（合作）的奖励与背叛之间的平衡，游戏会稳定下来，每个人都背叛每个人。在这种简单的情况下，每个人都输了。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The pursuit of knowledge, as seen in this study of game theory, is a gift from the Creator. As Daniel prophesied, in the end times, 'many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase.' This research, by adding complexity and nuance to simple models, reflects that ongoing human endeavor to understand the world around us.
reflection.zh: 正如本研究对博弈论的探索所示，对知识的追求是造物主的恩赐。正如但以理所预言的，在末世，“必有多人来往奔走，知识也必增长。”这项研究通过为简单的模型增加复杂性和细微差别，反映了人类不断理解周围世界的努力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Think of the parable of a frog in boiling water. That’s us dithering as the ‘unprecedented‘ weather becomes more extreme | Helen Pilcher
title.zh: 试想一下青蛙煮水的寓言。这就是我们迟疑不决的样子，因为‘前所未有’的天气变得越来越极端

summary.en: The article criticizes the public's complacency in the face of increasingly extreme weather events, likening it to a frog in boiling water that fails to recognize the danger. It notes how language has become trivialized, with words like 'awesome' and 'fantastic' losing their original meaning, mirroring a broader...
summary.zh: 文章批评公众在面对日益极端的天气事件时的自满情绪，将其比作一只身处沸水中却未能认识到危险的青蛙。文章指出，语言已变得琐碎，像‘awesome’和‘fantastic’这样的词语失去了原有的意义，这反映了社会普遍存在的将非凡的恶化常态化的倾向。

body.en: The complacency is staggering: just another hot summer, a flooded street, a crop failure. We are accepting this extraordinary deterioration as normal Recently, I overheard a conversation in a cafe where someone described their toast as “awesome”. I felt myself bristle. Not because the toast wasn’t good – I didn’t taste it – but because I remember a time when “awesome” meant something that inspired awe: towering mountains, the vastness of the night sky, the haunting song of a humpback whale. Now it’s being used to describe breakfast. “Fantastic” has met the same fate, shedding its fantastical origins to become a synonym for “great”. Meanwhile “literally” has been so thoroughly abused that it can now mean something that is, quite literally, not literal. Continue reading...
body.zh: 人们的自满情绪令人震惊：又是一个炎热的夏天，街道被洪水淹没，农作物歉收。我们正在接受这种非同寻常的恶化，这是正常的。 最近，我在一家咖啡馆里无意中听到一段对话，有人形容他们的吐司“棒极了”。我感觉自己浑身毛骨悚然。不是因为吐司不好——我没尝过——而是因为我记得曾经“棒极了”意味着一些令人敬畏的东西：高耸的山脉、浩瀚的夜空、座头鲸令人难忘的歌声。现在它被用来形容早餐。 “奇幻”也遭遇了同样的命运，摆脱了奇幻的起源，成为“伟大”的代名词。与此同时，“字面意思”已经被如此彻底地滥用，以至于它现在可以意味着某种从字面上看，而不是字面意思的东西。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author laments how even language, once used to describe profound experiences, is now reduced to describing breakfast. This trivialization reflects a deeper societal complacency, where extraordinary environmental changes are accepted as normal. We are called to guard our minds and focus on what is true and excellent, rather than letting our attention be...
reflection.zh: 作者哀叹，即使是曾经用来描述深刻体验的语言，如今也沦落到用来形容早餐。这种琐碎化反映了更深层次的社会自满情绪，即非凡的环境变化被视为常态。我们被呼召要守护我们的心思意念，专注于真实和卓越的事物，而不是让我们的注意力被平凡或被常态化的警报所麻木。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: First H5 bird flu death of endangered Australian sea lion recorded amid fears for small population
title.zh: 澳大利亚海狮首次记录到禽流感死亡，引发对该小种群的担忧

summary.en: South Australian authorities have recorded the first death of an endangered Australian sea lion from H5 bird flu. With fewer than 12,000 animals remaining, experts are concerned about the impact on this small population.
summary.zh: 南澳大利亚当局记录到一只濒危的澳大利亚海狮死于H5禽流感，这是该物种的首例。专家们对这一数量不足12,000只的种群的生存状况表示担忧。

body.en: South Australian authorities say case discovered on Kangaroo Island is first for species of which less than 12,000 animals remain Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast South Australia has recorded the first death of an endangered Australian sea lion from H5 bird flu. Experts say about 12,000 Australian sea lions remain – though a more recent estimate put the figure at less than 10,000. Most of the population are found in South Australia, with the remainder in Western Australia. Continue reading...
body.zh: 南澳大利亚当局表示，袋鼠岛发现的病例是首例仅剩不到 12,000 只动物的物种。 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 南澳大利亚记录了第一例濒临灭绝的澳大利亚海狮因 H5 禽流感死亡。专家表示，澳大利亚海狮的数量大约为 12,000 只，但最近的估计数字不到 10,000 只。大部分人口居住在南澳大利亚，其余人口居住在西澳大利亚。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of an endangered Australian sea lion succumbing to bird flu is a somber reminder of the delicate balance within creation. These unique creatures, part of the vast biodiversity of our planet, face threats that can quickly decimate their numbers. It calls us to appreciate the intricate web of life and the responsibility we have to protect it.
reflection.zh: 一只濒危的澳大利亚海狮死于禽流感的消息，令人沉痛地提醒我们，造物界内部存在着微妙的平衡。这些独特的生物，是我们星球上丰富生物多样性的一部分，正面临着可能迅速使其数量锐减的威胁。这促使我们去珍视生命的复杂网络，以及我们保护它的责任。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: How burnt coconut helped discover new to science endemic species in Sri Lanka
title.zh: 烧焦的椰子如何帮助在斯里兰卡发现新物种

summary.en: Researchers in Sri Lanka, facing challenges in attracting mice with traditional bait like peanut butter, successfully used pieces of burnt coconut to bait traps. This method led to the discovery of new species endemic to the region, found along the boundary of farmland and the Knuckles Mountain Range.
summary.zh: 斯里兰卡的研究人员在用花生酱等传统诱饵吸引老鼠方面遇到困难后，成功地使用烧焦的椰子块来诱捕。这种方法促成了在该地区特有的新物种的发现，这些物种在农田与 the Knuckles 山脉的边界地带被发现。

body.en: COLOMBO — As dusk settled over the paddy fields at Puwakpitiya, a village on the northern edge of Knuckles Mountain Range locally known as Dumbara mountains in Central Sri Lanka, researchers began laying traps along the uneasy boundary between farmland and forest. They were targeting small terrestrial mammals moving through the landscape. On the ground, drift fences were created to lead animals to pitfall traps, while box style Sherman live traps were baited with feed. But the usual rodent lure — peanut butter — failed to attract the mice in Sri Lanka, so the researchers instead turned to something more familiar to the local mice — pieces of burnt coconut. On March 11, 2004, one of the pitfall traps caught a small mouse that looked different. Six days later, a second specimen was caught in a baited trap. Both were females, not larger than a child’s palm, with fulvous-gray pelage broken by spiny guard hairs and a slender, naked tail longer than the head and body. Externally, the animal resembled Mayor’s mouse (Mus mayori), a species endemic to Sri Lanka’s highlands, but differed in tail length and head shape, offering initial clues about a new species. The species is so far known only from Sri Lanka’s Knuckles Mountain Range, and the image shows Puwakpitiya, the village from where researchers found the first specimens of Dumbara spiny mouse (Mus dumbara) after they set traps along the forest edge beside a sprawling paddy field. Image courtesy of Suyama Boyagoda. The two mice…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 科伦坡——当黄昏笼罩在普瓦克皮蒂亚（Puwakpitiya）的稻田上时，研究人员开始沿着农田和森林之间不稳定的边界设置陷阱。普瓦皮蒂亚是位于斯里兰卡中部纳克鲁斯山脉北缘的一个村庄，当地被称为敦巴拉山脉。他们的目标是在这片土地上移动的小型陆地哺乳动物。在地面上，人们建造了漂移围栏，将动物引向陷阱，而箱式谢尔曼活体陷阱则用饲料作为诱饵。但通常的啮齿动物诱饵——花生酱——未能吸引斯里兰卡的老鼠，因此研究人员转而使用当地老鼠更熟悉的东西——烧焦的椰子片。 2004年3月11日，其中一个陷阱捕获了一只长相不一样的小老鼠。六天后，第二个标本被诱饵陷阱捕获。两者都是雌性，不比孩子的手掌大，黄灰色的皮毛上布满了刺状的针毛，还有一条细长、裸露的尾巴，比头和身体还要长。从外观上看，这种动物类似于斯里兰卡高地特有的马耶鼠（Mus mayori），但尾长和头部形状不同，这为有关新物种的初步线索提供了线索。迄今为止，人们仅在斯里兰卡的指关节山脉发现该物种，图片显示了普瓦克皮蒂耶 (Puwakpitiya) 村庄，研究人员在一片广阔的稻田旁的森林边缘设置陷阱后，在这个村庄发现了第一批敦巴拉刺鼠 (Mus Dunbara) 标本。图片由 Suyama Boyagoda 提供。两只老鼠……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The discovery of new species in Sri Lanka, aided by the innovative use of burnt coconut as bait, reminds us that wisdom and insight can be found in the most unexpected places. The natural world, when observed closely, reveals Yahweh's intricate design and the abundance of life He has created.
reflection.zh: 在斯里兰卡发现新物种，借助烧焦椰子作为诱饵的创新使用，提醒我们智慧和洞察力可以在最意想不到的地方找到。大自然，当仔细观察时，揭示了雅伟精妙的设计和他所创造的生命的丰盛。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: We know how to prevent black lung, so why are workers still dying?
title.zh: 我们知道如何预防尘肺病，那为什么工人还在死去？

summary.en: Silicosis sufferers are getting younger as protections are rolled back by industry and political forces. Public health experts have known for decades how to prevent silicosis, an ancient workplace hazard, yet a new wave of workers are developing and dying from the disease as industry fights new protections and...
summary.zh: 随着行业和政治力量撤销防护措施，矽肺病患者越来越年轻。公共卫生专家几十年来一直知道如何预防矽肺病，这是一种古老的职业危害，但现在新一批工人却患上并死于这种疾病，因为行业在对抗新的防护措施，而监管机构未能捍卫现有的规则。约翰·罗宾逊的祖父在矿井里工作了几十年后患上了尘肺病，但罗宾逊在弗吉尼亚州西南部挖煤，却经历了这种疾病...

body.en: Silicosis sufferers are getting younger as Trump and the coal mining industry push back on protections Silicosis is one of the oldest workplace hazards and public health experts have known for decades how to prevent it. Yet a new wave of workers, from Appalachian coalminers to Latino countertop fabrication workers, are developing and dying from the disease as industry fights new protections and regulators fail to defend the rules that could protect them. John Robinson’s grandfather developed black lung back when coalminers could spend decades in the mines before being diagnosed with the disease, often dying in their 60s, 70s and 80s. But Robinson, who mined for coal in south-west Virginia, was diagnosed when he was 47. He’s part of a trend that has grown over the past two decades in central Appalachia, where more coalminers are developing black lung disease at younger ages. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着特朗普和煤炭开采业取消保护措施，矽肺患者变得越来越年轻。矽肺是最古老的工作场所危害之一，公共卫生专家几十年来就知道如何预防它。然而，随着行业与新的保护措施作斗争，而监管机构未能捍卫可以保护他们的规则，从阿巴拉契亚煤矿工人到拉丁裔台面制造工人的新一波工人正在发展并死于这种疾病。约翰·罗宾逊 (John Robinson) 的祖父患上了黑肺病，当时煤矿工人可能在矿井工作了几十年，然后才被诊断出患有这种疾病，通常在 60 多岁、70 多岁和 80 多岁的时候就去世了。但在弗吉尼亚州西南部开采煤矿的罗宾逊在 47 岁时被诊断出患有黑肺病。他属于阿巴拉契亚中部过去二十年发展趋势的一部分，那里越来越多的煤矿工人在年轻时患上黑肺病。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of younger workers succumbing to silicosis is a stark reminder that knowledge of prevention does not automatically translate into protection. Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy,' principles that seem absent when profit or regulatory rollback leads to preventable suffering. We are called to uphold justice for the vulnerable,...
reflection.zh: 年轻工人死于矽肺病的消息，严峻地提醒我们，预防知识并不能自动转化为保护。弥迦书6:8呼吁我们“施行公平，喜爱慈爱”，当利润或监管的倒退导致可预防的痛苦时，这些原则似乎荡然无存。我们蒙召要为弱势群体伸张正义，确保那些辛勤劳动的人不会因已知的危险而死去。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The push for a sustainable artisanal mining in the Peruvian Amazon
title.zh: 秘鲁亚马逊地区推动可持续手工金矿开采

summary.en: In Madre de Dios, Peru, thousands rely on gold mining, but mercury pollution and deforestation are devastating the Amazon's most biodiverse region. A formalized artisanal mining operation in La Pampa aims to demonstrate an alternative, seeking to produce 'clean gold' with mercury-free technology despite facing...
summary.zh: 在秘鲁马德雷德迪奥斯，数千人依赖金矿开采，但汞污染和森林砍伐正在摧毁亚马逊生物多样性最丰富的地区。拉潘帕的一个正规化手工金矿开采作业旨在展示另一种可能性，尽管面临巨大挑战，仍寻求使用无汞技术生产“清洁黄金”。

body.en: MADRE DE DIOS, Peru — In Madre de Dios, in the Peruvian Amazon, thousands of people depend on gold mining, while the spread of mercury and deforestation are transforming the country’s most biodiverse tropical forest. In La Pampa, one of the region’s main gold mining hubs, a formalized artisanal mining operation is trying to prove that another way of mining is possible. While facing roadblocks, violence, informal economies, and government neglect, it seeks to produce “clean gold” using mercury-free technologies. Through the daily lives of workers, merchants, and small-scale miners, the film explores the tensions between survival, pollution, and legitimacy in one of the Amazon’s most complex extractive economies. This video is supported by the Amazon Film Grant, as part of the One World Media Fellowship. Mongabay’s Video Team wants to cover questions and topics that matter to you. Are there any inspiring people, urgent issues, or local stories that you’d like us to cover? We want to hear from you. Be a part of our reporting process—get in touch with us here! Banner image: Gold nugget. ©Felipe Esparza. Why are forests vanishing in southeastern Liberia?This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 秘鲁马德雷德迪奥斯——在秘鲁亚马逊地区的马德雷德迪奥斯，成千上万的人依靠金矿开采为生，而汞的蔓延和森林砍伐正在改变该国生物多样性最丰富的热带森林。在该地区主要金矿开采中心之一的拉潘帕，正规化的手工采矿作业正试图证明另一种采矿方式是可行的。尽管面临障碍、暴力、非正规经济和政府忽视，该公司仍寻求利用无汞技术生产“清洁黄金”。影片通过工人、商人和小规模矿工的日常生活，探讨了亚马逊地区最复杂的采掘经济之一的生存、污染和合法性之间的紧张关系。该视频得到亚马逊电影补助金的支持，作为同一个世界媒体奖学金的一部分。 Mongabay 的视频团队希望涵盖您关心的问题和主题。您希望我们报道哪些鼓舞人心的人物、紧急问题或当地故事吗？我们希望收到您的来信。参与我们的报告流程 - 请在此处与我们联系！横幅图片：金块。 ©费利佩·埃斯帕扎。为什么利比里亚东南部的森林正在消失？本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The pursuit of 'clean gold' in Madre de Dios speaks to a deep human need to find ways to sustain ourselves without destroying the very environment that sustains us. Genesis 2:15 calls us to tend and keep the garden, a mandate that echoes in the efforts to mine responsibly amidst ecological crisis.
reflection.zh: 在马德雷德迪奥斯地区追求“清洁黄金”，反映了人类一种深层需求：在不摧毁赖以生存的环境的前提下找到可持续发展的方式。创世记2:15呼吁我们修理和看守园子，这一使命在生态危机中负责任地开采的努力中得到了回响。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: Ituna/Itatá invasion escalates as Indigenous Land faces fires and illegal clearing
title.zh: 巴西伊图纳/伊塔塔入侵升级，原住民土地面临火灾和非法砍伐

summary.en: Over 500 individuals have recently invaded Brazil's Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land, creating illegal roads, starting intentional fires, and threatening federal agents. This land is home to the Igarapé Ipiaçava Indigenous people, who live in voluntary isolation. A federal court ordered the deployment of security forces...
summary.zh: 近几周来，超过500人入侵了巴西的伊图纳/伊塔塔原住民土地，开辟非法道路，纵火焚烧，并威胁联邦特工。该地区是伊加拉佩伊皮亚萨瓦原住民的家园，他们过着与世隔绝的生活。联邦法院下令在48小时内部署国家公共安全部队以遏制入侵，但截至9月11日，部队尚未抵达。此次入侵发生在巴卡贾伊环境保护区（APA...

body.en: More than 500 people have invaded Brazil’s Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land in recent weeks, opening illegal roads, setting deliberate fires and threatening federal agents. The area is home to the Igarapé Ipiaçava Indigenous people who live in voluntary isolation with no contact with outsiders. On Aug. 26, a federal court ordered the government to deploy the National Public Security Force within 48 hours to contain the invasion. As of Sept 11, the forces hadn’t yet arrived. The recent invasion followed the creation of the Bacajaí Environmental Protection Area (APA Bacajaí) under a new state law, which allows private landowners to build homes and raise livestock. However, APA Bacajaí completely overlaps the federally protected Indigenous land in Pará state, creating legal confusion that authorities say has been weaponized by land-grabbers to justify occupation for cattle ranching and other agricultural activities. The Federal Public Prosecutor’s Office (MPF) has asked a federal court to fine the government 50,000 Brazilian reais (about $9,000) daily for failing to deploy enough security forces to contain the invasion. The area is currently under a temporary land-use restriction order to protect the isolated people living there. The government has argued it needs authorization from Pará’s government, which hasn’t cooperated. However, federal prosecutors say the federal government can be deployed on federal land without state authorization. Both the federal government and the state of Pará did not reply to Mongabay’s requests for comment by the time of publication. In its press statement, the MPF said the Indigenous Affairs Agency (Funai)…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 最近几周，超过 500 人入侵巴西伊图纳/伊塔塔原住民土地，非法开辟道路、蓄意纵火并威胁联邦特工。该地区是伊加拉佩·伊皮亚萨瓦 (Igarapé Ipiaçava) 原住民的家园，他们自愿隔离生活，不与外界接触。 8月26日，联邦法院命令政府在48小时内部署国家公共安全部队以遏制入侵。截至9月11日，部队尚未抵达。最近的入侵是在根据新的州法律创建巴卡贾伊环境保护区（APA Bacajaí）之后发生的，该法律允许私人土地所有者建造房屋和饲养牲畜。然而，APA Bacajaí 与帕拉州联邦保护的原住民土地完全重叠，造成了法律上的混乱，当局称这些土地已被土地掠夺者武器化，以证明占领养牛场和其他农业活动的合理性。联邦检察官办公室 (MPF) 已要求联邦法院对政府每天处以 50,000 巴西雷亚尔（约合 9,000 美元）的罚款，原因是政府未能部署足够的安全部队来遏制入侵。该地区目前处于临时土地使用限制令之下，以保护居住在那里的与世隔绝的人们。政府辩称需要获得帕拉州政府的授权，但帕拉州政府并未合作。然而，联邦检察官表示，联邦政府可以在未经州授权的情况下在联邦土地上部署。截至本文发表时，联邦政府和帕拉州均未回复 Mongabay 的置评请求。强积金在其新闻声明中表示，原住民事务局（Funai）……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The invasion of the Ituna/Itatá Indigenous Land in Brazil reveals a profound disregard for the sacredness of place and the rights of its inhabitants. As these lands face deliberate fires and illegal clearing, we are reminded that the Earth and all its fullness belong to Yahweh. The ongoing conflict underscores the deep human tendency to exploit and...
reflection.zh: 巴西伊图纳/伊塔塔原住民土地的入侵事件，暴露了对地方神圣性和居民权利的严重漠视。当这片土地面临蓄意纵火和非法砍伐时，我们被提醒，地和其中万物都属于雅伟。这场持续的冲突凸显了人类根深蒂固的倾向，即剥削和统治而非管理受造物。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Los Angeles to memorialize late mountain lion P-22 with sculpture in Griffith Park
title.zh: 洛杉矶将为已故山狮P-22在格里菲斯公园建造雕像

summary.en: The city of Los Angeles will honor the late mountain lion P-22, who resided in Griffith Park before his euthanasia in 2022 due to declining health, with a bronze sculpture in the park where he once roamed.
summary.zh: 洛杉矶市将为已故的山狮P-22建造一座铜像，P-22曾居住在格里菲斯公园，后于2022年因健康状况下降被安乐死。

body.en: The wild feline made its home in the park before being euthanized in 2022 after showing signs of declining health The city of Los Angeles will memorialize its most famous mountain lion with a bronze sculpture at Griffith Park, the 4,200-acre (1,700-hectare) stretch of land the cougar once roamed. Known as “P-22”, the number assigned by the team of biologists that first identified him, the lion gained national fame after photographer Steve Winter captured an iconic image of him prowling through Griffith Park with the Hollywood sign in the background. Continue reading...
body.zh: 这只野生猫科动物在公园里安家落户，但在表现出健康状况下降的迹象后，于 2022 年被安乐死。洛杉矶市将在格里菲斯公园 (Griffith Park) 建造一座青铜雕塑来纪念它最著名的山狮，这片美洲狮曾在这片占地 4,200 英亩（1,700 公顷）的土地上漫步。这头狮子被称为“P-22”，是由最先识别出它身份的生物学家团队指定的编号，摄影师史蒂夫·温特(Steve Winter)拍摄到了它在格里菲斯公园徘徊、背景是好莱坞标志的标志性照片后，这只狮子获得了全国性的声誉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story of P-22, a mountain lion who found a home in the urban landscape of Los Angeles's Griffith Park, reminds us of the intricate beauty of creation. Even in unexpected places, the natural world displays the wisdom and artistry of its Creator, inviting our awe and care. As we memorialize this wild creature, let us reflect on the profound truth that the...
reflection.zh: 山狮P-22的故事，它在洛杉矶格里菲斯公园的城市景观中找到了家园，提醒我们造物的精妙之美。即使在意想不到的地方，自然界也展现了其创造者的智慧和艺术，激发我们的敬畏和关怀。 当我们纪念这只野生动物时，让我们反思一个深刻的真理：诸天述说雅伟的荣耀，穹苍传扬祂的化工。如此动物在我们中间的存在和适应，指向那维系万有的神圣秩序。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

title.en: This wildflower paradise is only open six weeks a year. As soon as I entered, my mind started to calm
title.zh: 这座野花天堂每年只开放六周。我一进去，心就开始平静下来

summary.en: A nature park on the northern edge of Sydney, open for only six weeks a year during wildflower season, offers a profoundly peaceful experience, reminiscent of landscapes before Western intervention. Tickets for the Muogamarra nature reserve sold out quickly, with around 5,000 people expected to visit during its...
summary.zh: 悉尼北部边缘的一个自然公园，每年仅在野花季节开放六周，提供了一种深刻宁静的体验，让人想起西方干预之前的景观。穆奥马加拉自然保护区的门票很快售罄，预计在有限的开放时间内将有约 5000 人参观。

body.en: There is something profoundly peaceful about witnessing the Australian landscape as it used to be before western intervention On a cloudy Spring morning, a group of 20 nature enthusiasts gather at the entrance to a nature park on the northern edge of Sydney. “Good to see nobody is wearing thongs,” our volunteer tour leader, Helen Logie, says to chuckles. We are among just under 5,000 people lucky enough to visit Muogamarra nature reserve during the six weeks a year it is open to the public, coinciding with wildflower season. This year, tickets – which provide access to a limited number of guided and self-directed walks – sold out in less than a week. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在一个多云的春天早晨，20 名自然爱好者聚集在悉尼北部边缘的一个自然公园的入口处，目睹西方干预之前的景观，让人感到非常平静。 “很高兴看到没有人穿丁字裤，”我们的志愿者领队海伦·洛吉 (Helen Logie) 笑着说道。我们是不到 5,000 名有幸参观 Muogamarra 自然保护区的人之一，该保护区每年向公众开放六周，恰逢野花季节。今年，门票——提供有限数量的导游和自助徒步——在不到一周的时间内就售罄。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Muogamarra nature reserve offers a rare glimpse into a landscape untouched by rapid development, providing a sanctuary where visitors can find peace. This experience reminds us of the deep calm that can be found in nature, a gift from Yahweh that invites us to live in harmony with His creation.
reflection.zh: 穆奥马加拉自然保护区提供了一个难得的机会，得以一窥未受快速发展影响的景观，为游客提供了一个可以找到平静的避难所。这种体验提醒我们，在大自然中可以找到深刻的宁静，这是雅伟赐予的礼物，邀请我们与祂的创造和谐相处。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: The Breakdown of Natural Systems Could Intensify Warming by 30 Percent
title.zh: 自然系统失灵或加剧变暖30%

summary.en: As the planet warms, natural systems like tundras, wetlands, and forests are breaking down, releasing significant emissions that amplify human-caused warming. Research suggests these feedback loops could increase global warming by 20-30%, adding an additional 0.2 degrees Celsius even if net-zero emissions are achieved.
summary.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原解冻、湿地发酵、森林遭受更大更频繁的野火。这些自然系统的崩溃释放出巨量排放物，进一步加剧了化石燃料燃烧引起的气候变暖。研究表明，这种反馈循环可能将人类引起的气候变暖加剧20%至30%。

body.en:
As the planet heats up, tundras are thawing, wetlands are fermenting, and forests are succumbing to larger and more frequent wildfires. The breakdown of these natural systems is unleashing huge volumes of emissions, further intensifying warming from the burning of fossil fuels. According to new research, such feedback loops could amplify human-driven warming by 20 to 30 percent.

Even if humans reach net zero emissions later this century, feedbacks would add another 0.2 degrees C of warming, according to the modeling study , published this week in Environmental Research Letters. And if the world fails to reach net zero, and countries continue to produce some residual emissions through the end of this century, the added warming would be closer to 0.4 degrees C.

The world is already 1.4 degrees C hotter than in the preindustrial era, and fossil fuel emissions continue to grow, putting the Earth on course to surpass 2.5 degrees C of warming this century, scientists say, well in breach of international climate targets. And yet, while the added warming from feedback loops will further hasten the rise in temperatures, emissions from the breakdown of natural systems are largely absent from the most influential climate models, those that inform climate negotiations.

“This hidden multiplier is missing from the models guiding climate policy, so those models are likely underestimating how much warming is coming — and overestimating how much carbon we can still afford to emit,” said lead author Sam Abernethy, a researcher at Spark Climate Solutions, a San Francisco-based nonprofit that aims to identify climate “blind spots” and account for them in policy. ”To close that gap, we need to understand these processes better and build them into the models we rely on.”

The challenges are steep. Feedback loops are difficult to model, and emissions data is lacking in hard-to-reach places, such as Siberia or the Congo Basin. But as Yale Environment 360 recently reported , scientists around the world are now racing to forecast emissions from natural systems.

“If you’re not including all the emissions going into the atmosphere, you’re hamstrung from the get-go,” Brian Buma, a climate scientist at the Environmental Defense Fund, told e360 . “People are recognizing that the longer we go without taking these emissions into account, there’s just going to be a bigger gap.”
body.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原正在融化，湿地正在发酵，森林正在遭受更大、更频繁的野火的侵袭。这些自然系统的崩溃正在释放大量的排放物，进一步加剧了化石燃料燃烧造成的变暖。根据新的研究，这种反馈循环可能会将人类导致的变暖幅度放大 20% 至 30%。 根据本周发表在《环境研究快报》上的模型研究，即使人类在本世纪晚些时候达到净零排放，反馈也会使气温再增加 0.2 摄氏度。如果世界未能实现净零排放，并且各国在本世纪末继续产生一些残余排放，则升温幅度将接近 0.4 摄氏度。 科学家表示，世界温度已经比工业化前时代高出 1.4 摄氏度，而化石燃料排放量继续增加，使地球本世纪升温将超过 2.5 摄氏度，这远远违反了国际气候目标。然而，虽然反馈循环带来的额外变暖将进一步加速气温上升，但最有影响力的气候模型（为气候谈判提供信息的模型）基本上不存在自然系统崩溃造成的排放。 “指导气候政策的模型中缺少这个隐藏的乘数，因此这些模型可能低估了即将到来的变暖程度，并高估了我们仍然能够承受的碳排放量，”主要作者萨姆·阿伯内西（Sam Abernethy）说，他是旧金山非营利组织 Spark Climate Solutions 的研究员，旨在识别气候“盲点”并在政策中加以考虑。 “为了缩小这一差距，我们需要更好地理解这些过程，并将它们构建到我们依赖的模型中。” 挑战是严峻的。反馈回路很难建模，西伯利亚或刚果盆地等难以到达的地方缺乏排放数据。但正如耶鲁环境 360 最近报道的那样，世界各地的科学家现在正在竞相预测自然系统的排放量。 美国环境保护基金会的气候科学家布莱恩·布马 (Brian Buma) 告诉 e360：“如果不包括进入大气中的所有排放量，那么从一开始就会受到阻碍。” “人们认识到，不考虑这些排放的时间越长，差距就会越大。”

reflection.en: The prophet Paul speaks of all creation groaning in labor pains, awaiting its ultimate redemption. This news highlights how our planet's natural systems are indeed suffering under the strain of human activity, releasing emissions that worsen the crisis. It calls us to recognize the interconnectedness of all things and our responsibility to care for the...
reflection.zh: 使徒保罗说，万物都在一同劳苦叹息，直到如今，等待着终极的救赎。这则新闻揭示了我们星球的自然系统确实承受着人类活动的重压而痛苦，释放出加剧危机的排放物。这提醒我们认识到万物相互关联，以及我们有责任照管雅伟曾宣告为“甚好”的地球。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Sargassum Superbloom: Seaweed Scourge or Ecological Boon?
title.zh: 马尾藻超量繁殖：海藻灾害还是生态福音？

summary.en: A massive bloom of sargassum seaweed, stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, is inundating beaches and harming coastal wildlife. However, scientists have found that this floating algae supports a diverse array of marine life, leading some to advocate for its protection.
summary.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾的大规模马尾藻繁殖，正淹没海滩并危害沿海野生动物。然而，科学家发现这种漂浮的海藻支撑着各种各样的海洋生物，这使得一些人开始呼吁保护它。

body.en:
Stretching from West Africa to the Gulf of Mexico, a massive bloom of sargassum seaweed is swamping beaches and killing coastal wildlife. But scientists have discovered the floating algae also shelters a vast array of ocean creatures, and some are now calling for its protection.

Many of America’s favorite beaches in Florida and the Caribbean have been piled high with foul-smelling seaweed again this summer, often in record amounts. What disappointed tourists may not know is that the inundations, which also smother coral reefs, mangroves, and seagrasses, are just the most visible sign of a vast new marine ecosystem — an expanse of floating sargassum that since 2011 has seemingly come from nowhere to spread in a 5,500-mile-long belt from Mexico to West Africa and Florida to Brazil.

The dense mats of offshore weed grow up to 20 feet thick, and this summer reached a record weight of 38 million metric tons — more than the total weight of all Americans.

The seaweed scourge is wrecking coastal economies in countries heavily dependent on tourism and fishing. The coastlines of 30 countries across the Caribbean and beyond are being visited by the brown mats piling up on beaches, where the weed decomposes, releasing gases such as hydrogen sulfide, with its distinctive rotten-egg smell, and ammonia, which trigger asthma attacks and exacerbate other respiratory conditions. Thousands of victims have been reported by doctors in the Caribbean, especially among workers clearing beaches.

The weed also blocks water intakes and prevents fishers from taking their boats to sea, as well as clogging their nets, engines, and propellers. It has caused mass deaths of marine life on coastlines, while preventing sea turtles from laying their eggs on beaches and blocking hatchlings trying to return to the ocean. The weed also accumulates heavy metals such as arsenic, which leaches out as the weed decomposes on land and can poison water supplies.

Subscribe to the E360 Newsletter for weekly updates delivered to your inbox. Sign Up .

But, while acknowledging its onshore harms, some researchers are now recognizing the Great Atlantic Sargassum Belt as a significant new habitat for marine life in the open ocean, and a valuable carbon sink for the planet. According to Jonathan Jung, a marine ecologist at the Max Planck Institute for Chemistry in Mainz, Germany, the weed and its growing army of inhabitants now form “the largest interconnected floating biome on Earth.”

Sargassum seaweed in the Atlantic was once mostly confined to the Sargasso Sea, an area of sluggish waters off Bermuda largely cut off from the rest of the ocean by rotating ocean currents. It has been well-known to mariners since Christopher Columbus reported sailing through “so much grass that it looked like the...
body.zh: 从西非一直延伸到墨西哥湾，大量的马尾藻海藻正在淹没海滩并杀死沿海野生动物。但科学家发现，这些漂浮的藻类也为大量海洋生物提供了庇护，一些海洋生物现在呼吁保护它们。 今年夏天，美国佛罗里达州和加勒比海地区许多最受欢迎的海滩再次堆满了恶臭的海藻，数量往往达到创纪录的水平。失望的游客可能不知道的是，洪水也淹没了珊瑚礁、红树林和海草，而这只是一个巨大的新海洋生态系统最明显的标志——自 2011 年以来，一大片漂浮的马尾藻似乎不知从何而来，在从墨西哥到西非、从佛罗里达到巴西的 5,500 英里长的带上蔓延。 近海杂草丛生，厚度可达 20 英尺，今年夏天的重量达到创纪录的 3800 万吨——超过了所有美国人的总重量。 海藻祸害正在破坏严重依赖旅游业和渔业的国家的沿海经济。加勒比海及其他地区30个国家的海岸线正被堆积在海滩上的棕色垫子所覆盖，这些杂草在海滩上分解，释放出硫化氢等气体，具有独特的臭鸡蛋味，还有氨气，会引发哮喘发作并加剧其他呼吸道疾病。加勒比地区的医生报告了数千人的受害者，特别是清理海滩的工人。 这种杂草还会阻塞进水口，阻止渔民将船出海，并堵塞渔网、发动机和螺旋桨。它导致海岸线海洋生物大量死亡，同时阻止海龟在海滩上产卵，并阻止试图返回海洋的幼龟。这种杂草还会积累砷等重金属，当杂草在陆地上分解时，砷会渗出，污染水源。 订阅 E360 新闻通讯，每周更新发送到您的收件箱。报名 。 但是，在承认其陆上危害的同时，一些研究人员现在认识到大大西洋马尾藻带是公海海洋生物的重要新栖息地，也是地球宝贵的碳汇。德国美因茨马克斯·普朗克化学研究所的海洋生态学家乔纳森·荣格表示，这种杂草及其不断增长的居民大军现在形成了“地球上最大的相互关联的漂浮生物群落”。 大西洋中的马尾藻海藻曾经主要局限于马尾藻海，这是百慕大附近的一个缓慢水域，由于旋转洋流，基本上与海洋其他部分隔绝。自从克里斯托弗·哥伦布报道航行穿过“如此多的草，看起来就像……”以来，它就为水手们所熟知。

reflection.en: The vast expanse of sargassum seaweed, initially seen as a scourge, is revealing itself as a complex ecosystem teeming with life. This reminds us that even in what appears problematic, Yahweh's intricate design is at work, with creation itself bearing witness to His wisdom and power. As Romans 1:20 says, His invisible attributes are clearly perceived, being...
reflection.zh: 最初被视为灾难的马尾藻大片海藻，正逐渐显露出其作为复杂生态系统的面貌，其中充满了生命。这提醒我们，即使在看似有问题的事物中，雅伟精妙的设计也在运作，而祂的创造本身就见证了祂的智慧与大能。正如罗马书1:20所说，祂的永恒大能和神性，自从创造世界以来，藉着所造之物就可以晓得。

verse.textEn: Since the creation of the world God's invisible qualities — his eternal power and divine nature — have been clearly seen, being understood from what has been made.
verse.textZh: 自从造天地以来，神的永能和神性是明明可知的，虽是眼不能见，但借着所造之物就可以晓得。

The film, produced by The Guardian, derives its title from an Israeli military term for expected 'collateral casualties' and features testimony from intelligence...

The Guardian-produced film takes its title from an Israeli military term for expected 'collateral casualties' and is built around testimony from intelligence officers and soldiers involved in the war
body.zh: 关于加沙平民死亡人数的纪录片《NAZA》在威尼斯电影节首映式上获得了长达 25 分钟的起立鼓掌。这部由《卫报》制作的影片的标题取自以色列军事术语，意为预期的“附带伤亡”，并以参与战争的情报官员和士兵的证词为基础

reflection.en: The film 'NAZA' brings the often-unseen civilian toll of conflict into sharp focus, giving voice to those who have suffered immense loss. By centering the testimonies of those impacted, the documentary serves as a powerful act of advocacy, reminding us of our call to speak for the voiceless and bear witness to their stories.
reflection.zh: 纪录片《NAZA》将冲突中常常被忽视的平民伤亡情况置于聚光灯下，为那些遭受巨大损失的人们发声。通过聚焦受影响者的证词，这部纪录片成为一项有力的倡导行动，提醒我们有责任为无声者代言，并见证他们的故事。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.

A man and a woman were murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly fell on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family...

body.en: In HBO’s gripping new docuseries A Killer Story, a crusading couple become convinced that woman accused of murder is innocent A man and a woman are murdered in cold blood inside their Topeka, Kansas, bedroom under cover of darkness in 2002. Suspicion quickly falls on the man’s ex-wife, Dana Chandler, with family and forensic evidence painting her as the jealous type. But the county prosecutor at the time declines to pursue charges in large part because nothing places Chandler at the scene of the crime. It’s only after a politically motivated prosecutor is appointed and CBS’s 48 Hours airs a 2009 report rehashing the case that Chandler is arrested on two counts of premeditated first-degree murder in 2011 and condemned to consecutive life sentences the following year. No doubt: the story is hot copy. And more than likely, Chandler’s conviction marks the conclusion if a husband-and-wife team of true crime enthusiasts hadn’t become convinced that the real killer was still walking free. “There’s a lot of questions that remain,” says film-maker Matthew Galkin. “But when you start to unpack the crime itself, there’s a lot of hoops to jump through and a very high bar to clear in order for her to have pulled this off.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在 HBO 扣人心弦的新纪录片《杀手故事》中，一对斗志昂扬的夫妇确信被指控谋杀的女子是无辜的。 2002 年，一名男子和一名女子在黑暗的掩护下，在堪萨斯州托皮卡的卧室里被冷血谋杀。嫌疑人很快就落到了该男子的前妻达纳·钱德勒的身上，家人和法医证据都将她描绘成嫉妒型的人。但当时的县检察官拒绝提出指控，很大程度上是因为没有任何证据显示钱德勒在犯罪现场。直到任命了一位出于政治动机的检察官，并且哥伦比亚广播公司的 48 小时频道播出了 2009 年的报道，重述了此案之后，钱德勒才于 2011 年因两项预谋一级谋杀罪被捕，并在次年被连续判处无期徒刑。毫无疑问：这个故事是热门副本。如果一对真正的犯罪爱好者组成的夫妻团队没有相信真正的凶手仍然逍遥法外，那么钱德勒的定罪很可能标志着一个结论。 “还有很多问题没有解决，”电影制片人马修·加尔金说。 “但是，当你开始揭开犯罪本身的真相时，为了让她成功完成这件事，有很多障碍需要跨越，还有很高的门槛需要克服。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary series delves into the complexities of true crime, where a couple's conviction of innocence challenges the initial accusations. It reminds us of the importance of seeking truth and not settling for the first or loudest narrative. Proverbs 18:17 speaks to this, stating that 'The first person to speak in a lawsuit seems right, until someone...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片系列深入探讨了真实犯罪的复杂性，其中一对夫妇坚信某女子无辜，这挑战了最初的指控。它提醒我们寻求真相的重要性，不要满足于第一个或最响亮的声音。箴言18:17对此有所阐述，‘在讼事上先开口的，似乎都有理；但邻 Comes，就审问他。’

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

body.en: Venice film festival: Alex Gibney interviews former colleagues, wives, the trillionaire’s father and a CG avatar in this absorbing documentary ‘Elon is a nuke.” The speaker is Ashley St Clair, a former conservative Maga influencer and one of Elon Musk’s former girlfriends-slash-baby mommas. She is a fascinating expert witness in Alex Gibney’s four-hour epic study of the world’s richest and dullest man: the overgrown brattish South-African-born trillionaire plutocrat, ersatz visionary and Trump courtier who owns Tesla cars, SpaceX rocket ships, Starlink satellites on which nation states’ military capabilities are increasingly reliant, X (formerly Twitter) which shapes the collective incel id of billions and GrokAI whose vast server farms daily guzzle oceans of precious water. Continue reading...
body.zh: 威尼斯电影节：亚历克斯·吉布尼在这部引人入胜的纪录片《埃隆是核武器》中采访了他的前同事、妻子、亿万富翁的父亲和 CG 头像。演讲者是阿什利·圣克莱尔 (Ashley St Clair)，她是一位前保守派 Maga 影响者，也是埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的前女友、斜线婴儿妈妈之一。在亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）对世界上最富有和最愚钝的人的长达四个小时的史诗般的研究中，她是一位引人入胜的专家证人：出生于南非的亿万富翁，是一个过于自大、脾气暴躁的亿万富豪、冒牌的梦想家和特朗普的朝臣，拥有特斯拉汽车、SpaceX火箭飞船、民族国家军事能力越来越依赖的星链卫星、塑造了数十亿集体非自愿群体的X（以前的推特）和每天都有庞大服务器群的GrokAI吞噬海洋宝贵的水资源。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary probes the immense power and influence of Elon Musk, a figure who wields vast technological control. The narrative describes him as an 'ersatz visionary,' suggesting a disconnect between his ambition and true wisdom. This echoes the ancient story of Babel, where human ambition and technological prowess sought to reach the heavens,...
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片深入探讨了埃隆·马斯克——这位拥有巨大技术控制权的人物——的巨大权力和影响力。叙述将他描述为一位“伪造的远见者”，暗示了他的野心与真正的智慧之间存在脱节。这让人联想到古代巴别塔的故事，当时人类的野心和技术实力试图触及天堂，最终导致了混乱和分裂。

verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

summary.en: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary. summary.zh: 导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找两位过着与世隔绝生活的兄弟，他们在超现实的纪录片中展现出奇特的智慧。这部由一头被屠宰的公牛旁白的非凡电影，走了一条不寻常的道路，记录了一对捷克双胞胎兄弟的日常生活。弗兰蒂谢克和奥德雷·克利希克兄弟俩在舒马瓦山脉的一间小屋里，正慢慢走向疯狂——或者说接近开悟。导演米罗·雷莫以阿莱什·帕兰关...

body.en: Director Miro Remo journeys deep into the Czech countryside to find two brothers living an isolated life filled with quixotic wisdom in this surreal documentary Narrated by a slaughtered bull, this extraordinary film takes the less-travelled path in charting the daily life of a pair of Czech twins a long way off conventional routes themselves. František and Ondřej Klišík are slowly going mad – or maybe closing in on enlightenment – in a cabin in the Šumava mountains and, extrapolating a short story about the brothers by Aleš Palán, director Miro Remo succumbs productively to the prevailing cabin fever – not only egging these longbeards on in their squabbling and loopy philosophising, but pitching in with his own fabulism and surrealism. Closing on 60, “Franta” and “Ondra” still farm their smallholding with the help of Nandy, a mutinous bull ill-chosen as a draught animal. In their downtime, they booze, banter and bicker, lament their lack of prospects with the fairer sex, and blow off steam in epic arm-wrestling bouts. Despite an arm lost to a sawmill accident, it’s Franta who’s usually the victor; he is also possessed by a quixotic streak absent in his bluff sibling. Letting loose streams of poetry into the air like bunting, wishing “joy to all conscious beings”, he is also constructing his own Da Vinci-style perpetual flying machine. “Your aversion to my perpetuum is a little annoying,” he informs the exasperated Ondra. Continue reading...
body.zh: 在这部超现实的纪录片中，导演米罗·雷莫深入捷克乡村，寻找充满堂吉诃德式智慧的两兄弟过着与世隔绝的生活。这部非凡的影片由一头被宰杀的公牛讲述，采取了一条人迹罕至的道路，描绘了一对捷克双胞胎的日常生活，远离传统路线。弗兰蒂谢克和昂德热·克利希克在苏马瓦山的一间小屋里慢慢发疯——或者可能接近启蒙，导演米罗·雷莫根据阿莱什·帕兰写的关于兄弟俩的短篇小说，有效地屈服于盛行的小屋热——不仅怂恿这些长胡子的人争吵和疯狂的哲学思考，还用自己的寓言和超现实主义。截至 60 日，“Franta”和“Ondra”仍在南迪（Nandy）的帮助下耕种他们的小农场，南迪是一头叛变的公牛，被错误地选为役畜。在闲暇时间，她们会喝酒、开玩笑、争吵，哀叹自己与异性交往的前景不佳，并在史诗般的扳手腕比赛中发泄情绪。尽管弗兰塔在锯木厂事故中失去了一条手臂，但通常胜利者都是弗兰塔。他还具有他那直率的兄弟所没有的不切实际的性格。他像彩旗一样将诗意的溪流抛向空中，祝愿“所有有意识的生物都快乐”，他也在建造自己的达芬奇式永久飞行器。 “你对我的永生体的厌恶有点烦人，”他告诉愤怒的昂德拉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This documentary explores the lives of two brothers living in isolation, questioning whether their path leads to madness or enlightenment. It reminds us that each life, however unconventional, is a unique creation. We are all fearfully and wonderfully made, with paths and wisdom that may not fit societal norms but are part of a divine design.
reflection.zh: 这部纪录片探讨了两位隐居兄弟的生活，质疑他们的道路是通向疯狂还是开悟。它提醒我们，每一个生命，无论多么不寻常，都是独特的创造。我们都是被雅伟用奇妙的方式造的，我们的道路和智慧或许不符合社会规范，但却是神圣设计的一部分。

verse.textEn: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.
verse.textZh: 我要称谢你，因我受造奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。

title.en: Oasis: Don't Look Back In Anger review - emotional documentary glosses over the hard stuff
title.zh: Oasis：不再愤怒回顾 - 情感纪录片忽略了艰难的部分

summary.en: The film captures the euphoria of Oasis' comeback, but fails to explore the story of their reunion.
summary.zh: 这部电影捕捉到了Oasis乐队重组后的狂喜，但未能深入探讨他们重聚的故事。

body.en:
"The little things that used to annoy us about each other have all gone away," says Noel Gallagher of reconciling with his brother, Liam.

The scene comes towards the end of Don't Look Back In Anger, a sentimental and affectionate portrait of the band's comeback tour in 2025. But it's about as deep as we get into the band's 15-year hiatus.

In an opening montage, we hear how Oasis conquered the world in the 1990s with hits like Wonderwall and Roll With It. As their fame grew, so did the brothers' animosity, until the party came to an abrupt halt backstage at a gig in Paris in 2009.

Fan shot footage shows the promoter on stage, informing the crowd that the concert is cancelled following "a huge fight together in the dressing room".

"The band doesn't exist any more," he announces, sounding more irritated than sad.

According to Scottish singer Amy McDonald, who was also on the line-up, the altercation was seismic. "Liam smashed Noel's guitar, huuuge fight!" she tweeted from backstage.

The film, however, never tells us what was said. Nobody explains the fall-out. We don't find out who instigated the rapprochement, nor do we hear how it affected their family.

Instead, we cut to rehearsals for the comeback tour, with a caption informing us the brothers "didn't speak for 15 years", and an implication that all the wounds have been miraculously healed.

Tantalisingly, the first song they practice is Columbia - a fan favourite that never made the tour's setlist - but there's a tension in the room.

The band, under Noel's instruction, is piecing together the setlist. Liam won't arrive until later in the process, and no-one's sure which Liam they'll get.

When he arrives, he seems fantastically grumpy, complaining about the sound-proofing panels that have been placed in front of Joey Waronker's drums.

But when he steps up to the mic, the band relax. Guitarist Bonehead - who's strategically placed between Liam and Noel - beams from ear to ear.

A couple of hours later, still in the middle of a song, Liam waves goodbye and casually strolls out of the rehearsal space.

"If you're not on it, chaos can ensue," he says, adding that he's given up cigarettes and alcohol (the intoxicants, not the song) for the duration of the tour.

Liam's newfound professionalism is probably the biggest revelation in the documentary, scripted by Peaky Blinders' creator Steven Knight, and shot by directors Dylan Southern and Will Lovelace.

To their presumable dismay, there are no scenes of the singer quitting the tour to go house-hunting , external ; throwing snooker balls at Blur , external ; or starting a fight on a cross-channel ferry .

Instead, they complete rehearsals without incident and rock up to Cardiff's Principality Stadium for their public reunion.

As the big moment...
body.zh: “曾经让我们彼此烦恼的小事都消失了，”诺埃尔·加拉格尔在谈到与弟弟利亚姆和解时说道。 这一场景出现在《Don’t Look Back In Anger》的结尾处，这是对乐队 2025 年回归巡演的感伤和深情的描绘。但这与我们进入乐队 15 年的停顿一样深。 在开场蒙太奇中，我们了解到 Oasis 如何在 20 世纪 90 年代凭借《Wonderwall》和《Roll With It》等热门歌曲征服世界。随着他们的名气越来越大，兄弟俩的仇恨也越来越大，直到 2009 年巴黎一场演出的后台派对突然停止。 粉丝拍摄的镜头显示，发起人在舞台上，通知观众，在“更衣室里发生了一场激烈的争斗”后，音乐会被取消。 “乐队已经不存在了，”他宣布，听起来更多的是恼怒而不是悲伤。 据也在场的苏格兰歌手艾米·麦克唐纳 (Amy McDonald) 表示，这场争吵是令人震惊的。 “利亚姆砸碎了诺埃尔的吉他，打架！”她在后台发推文。 然而，这部电影从未告诉我们所说的内容。没有人解释后果。我们不知道是谁促成了和解，也不知道这对他们的家庭有何影响。 相反，我们切入了复出巡演的排练，字幕告诉我们兄弟俩“15年没有说话了”，并暗示所有的伤口都奇迹般地痊愈了。 令人着迷的是，他们练习的第一首歌是《Columbia》——这是一首深受粉丝喜爱的歌曲，但从未出现在巡演的歌单中——但房间里却充满了紧张气氛。 乐队在诺埃尔的指导下正在拼凑歌单。利亚姆要到这个过程的后期才会到达，而且没有人确定他们会得到哪一个利亚姆。 当他到达时，他似乎脾气暴躁，抱怨乔伊·沃龙克鼓前面的隔音板。 但当他走到麦克风前时，乐队放松了。吉他手 Bonehead - 战略性地位于 Liam 和 Noel 之间 - 笑容满面。 几个小时后，利亚姆还在唱着歌，挥手告别，漫不经心地走出排练场。 “如果你不参加，混乱就会随之而来，”他说，并补充说他在巡演期间戒掉了香烟和酒精（麻醉品，而不是歌曲）。 利亚姆新发现的专业精神可能是这部纪录片中最大的启示，这部纪录片由《浴血黑帮》的创作者史蒂文·奈特编写剧本，由导演迪伦·萨瑟恩和威尔·洛夫莱斯拍摄。 令他们沮丧的是，没有歌手退出巡演去外部找房的场景；将斯诺克球扔到 Blur 外部；或者在跨海峡渡轮上打架。 相反，他们顺利地完成了排练，并在卡迪夫公国体育场举行了公开重聚。 作为重要时刻...

reflection.en: Noel Gallagher's comment that "the little things that used to annoy us about each other have all gone away" speaks to a reconciliation that, while welcome, feels superficial. The documentary, by glossing over the "hard stuff" of their 15-year hiatus, misses an opportunity to explore how true healing and reconciliation occur, not just the absence of...
reflection.zh: 诺埃尔·加拉格尔说“那些曾经让我们互相恼怒的小事都消失了”，这番话暗示了一种和解，虽然值得欢迎，但感觉有些肤浅。这部纪录片在略过他们15年休眠期的“艰难部分”时，错失了一个探讨真正治愈与和解如何发生的机会，而不仅仅是烦恼的消失。它提醒我们，克服过去的伤害需要的不只是恢复正常；它呼唤我们积极地选择良善，以对抗过往冲突留下的痕迹。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

body.en: Football manager José Mourinho stars in a three-parter from the creators of Bros: After the Screaming Stops. Don’t expect it to be quite so entertaining … Among his previous credits, the director of this mini-series Joe Pearlman can count the revelatory and hilarious 2018 film, Bros: After the Screaming Stops . That documentary worked brilliantly because its subjects seemed so sweetly but devastatingly lacking in discretion or self-awareness that everything they said landed like a line from a Christopher Guest parody. They couldn’t help themselves. In terms of a character study, storied football manager José Mourinho is a very different kettle of cold fish. Like the Goss twins, he takes himself very seriously indeed, but that’s pretty much where the similarities end. He’s something of a closed book. “You are pushing me to speak about myself,” he says, towards the end of the final part of this series. “And I don’t want to.” Which is fair enough but it does beg the question: why then, would you agree to be the subject of an in-depth three part documentary series? Mourinho is on Netflix Continue reading...
body.zh: 足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥在《兄弟：尖叫停止之后》创作者制作的三部曲中担任主演。别指望它会这么有趣……在这部迷你剧的导演乔·皮尔曼 (Joe Pearlman) 之前的作品中，可以数 2018 年的一部具有启发性和搞笑性的电影《兄弟：尖叫停止后》。这部纪录片取得了出色的效果，因为它的主题看起来如此甜蜜，但严重缺乏判断力或自我意识，以至于他们所说的一切都像克里斯托弗·盖斯特（Christopher Guest）戏仿中的台词一样。他们无法自拔。就性格研究而言，传奇足球经理何塞·穆里尼奥是一个非常不同的冷鱼。和戈斯双胞胎一样，他确实非常认真地对待自己，但相似之处也仅此而已。他就像一本合上的书。 “你迫使我谈论我自己，”他在本系列最后一部分的结尾说道。 “而我不想。”这很公平，但它确实引出了一个问题：那么，为什么你会同意成为一个深入的三部分纪录片系列的主题呢？穆里尼奥在 Netflix 上继续阅读...

This reminds us that fame and public attention, like a refiner's fire, test a person's true character, revealing what lies beneath the surface. When given a stage, our authenticity is often put to the test, showing whether we are willing...
reflection.zh: 穆里尼奥的纪录片因他不愿真正敞开心扉而受到批评，尽管它提供了一个公共平台。这提醒我们，名声和公众关注，如同炼金的炉火，考验着一个人的真实品格，揭示其表象之下的本质。当我们被赋予一个舞台时，我们的真诚往往会受到考验，展现我们是否愿意被真实地了解。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.

title.en: Monsters of God review – a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers gets the Tiger King treatment
title.zh: 《上帝的怪物》影评：一场爬行动物走私犯之间的混乱恩怨，获得“虎王”式待遇

summary.en: A new documentary, "Monsters of God," explores the underworld of the animal trade through the lens of a messy feud between rival reptile smugglers. Director Eric Goode presents two figures whose intense rivalry and accusations are compared to the popular "Tiger King" series, highlighting the dramatic and often absurd...
summary.zh: 一部名为《上帝的怪物》的新纪录片，通过两位敌对爬行动物走私犯之间混乱的恩怨，探讨了动物贸易的地下世界。导演埃里克·古德呈现的这两个人物，他们之间激烈的竞争和相互指控被比作热门剧集《虎王》，揭示了这个非法世界中戏剧性且往往荒谬的冲突。

body.en: Director Eric Goode has found two enemies to rival Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin in his new documentary about the animal trade’s underworld Through the fear and general miasma of the Covid pandemic, TV brought people together like never before. Among the most-watched series of 2020 was of course Tiger King, Netflix’s hit about an improbably twisty feud between a gay, polyamorous big-cat breeder and convicted felon, and the conservationist rival whom he accused of murder (more specifically, of feeding her missing husband to the tigers in her sanctuary – which she denies). It was the perfect hit for quarantine: bold and ridiculous enough to get everyone talking, and with precisely no bearing on the grief and awfulness that was all around. Producer and co-director Eric Goode has made a smattering of Tiger King follow-ups since then, as well as another series, Chimp Crazy, about the self-described Dolly Parton of the primate world. His latest project – a co-production between his own outfit, Goode Films, HBO, and A24 – continues the theme, focusing this time on the reptile trade and taking its lead from the 2008 book The Lizard King by journalist Bryan Christy. It’s stuffed full of wild stories and even wilder characters: there are canny smugglers, underworld crime gangs, and even legitimate zoos that are said to have turned a blind eye to the provenance of their big, scaly friends. The series is centred on the US – although clearly the supply chain is global – and the two men who kickstarted the illegal trade: Hank Molt and copycat trader Tommy Crutchfield. Like Joe Exotic and Carole Baskin before them, there is no love lost between Crutchfield and Molt, and no odd biographical detail too trivial to skip over. Hank, says Tommy, “will turn anything good into bad”, while Hank reckons that Tommy is “one of the angriest and most bitter people I’ve ever met”. Along the way we learn that Hank used to be a mayonnaise salesman, and that Tommy worked at an extremely on-the-nose Florida establishment named Snake-a-Torium as a teenager, where he would later have his wedding reception. What follows is the story not only of their enduring beef and betrayals, but of other adjacent vendettas in the illicit reptilian market. Despite environmental concerns becoming increasingly en vogue in the late 60s, a “don’t ask, don’t tell” attitude still pervaded the world of wildlife trading, with many zoos happy to acquire what they needed from whoever happened to have it. There were, however, serious consequences for some of the creatures involved. With the police on his back, Molt once buried a stash of animals alive in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens, a location which would later become infamous via The Sopranos. When he was eventually arrested, Crutchfield would become the go-to...
body.zh: 导演埃里克·古德（Eric Goode）在他关于动物贸易黑社会的新纪录片中找到了两个可以与乔·异国情调（Joe Exotic）和卡罗尔·巴斯金（Carole Baskin）匹敌的敌人。在新冠疫情的恐惧和普遍的瘴气中，电视以前所未有的方式将人们聚集在一起。 2020 年收视率最高的剧集当然是《虎王》，这部 Netflix 热播剧讲述了一名同性恋、多角恋大型猫科动物饲养员和被定罪的重罪犯，以及他指控谋杀（更具体地说，将她失踪的丈夫喂给她庇护所里的老虎——她否认）的自然资源保护主义竞争对手之间的矛盾。这是隔离期间的完美打击：大胆而荒谬，足以让每个人都议论纷纷，却与周围的悲伤和可怕毫无关系。从那时起，制片人兼联合导演埃里克·古德制作了一些《虎王》的后续作品，以及另一部剧集《疯狂黑猩猩》，讲述了自称灵长类动物世界的多莉·帕顿的故事。他的最新项目——由他自己的公司 Goode Films、HBO 和 A24 联合制作——延续了这一主题，这次重点关注爬行动物贸易，并以记者 Bryan Christy 2008 年出版的《蜥蜴王》一书为主导。它充满了疯狂的故事，甚至更疯狂的人物：有精明的走私者、黑社会犯罪团伙，甚至还有据说对他们的大而有鳞的朋友的出处视而不见的合法动物园。该系列以美国为中心（尽管供应链显然是全球性的）以及发起非法贸易的两个人：汉克·莫尔特（Hank Molt）和模仿商人汤米·克拉奇菲尔德（Tommy Crutchfield）。就像之前的乔·异国情调和卡罗尔·巴斯金一样，克拉奇菲尔德和莫尔特之间没有失去爱情，也没有琐碎而无法跳过的奇怪的传记细节。汤米说，汉克“会把任何好事变成坏事”，而汉克认为汤米是“我见过的最愤怒、最痛苦的人之一”。一路上我们了解到，汉克曾经是一名蛋黄酱推销员，而汤米十几岁时曾在佛罗里达州一家名为 Snake-a-Torium 的非常引人注目的餐厅工作，后来他在那里举办了婚宴。接下来的故事不仅讲述了他们持久的争执和背叛，还讲述了非法爬行动物市场上其他相邻的仇杀。尽管环境问题在 20 世纪 60 年代末变得越来越流行，但“不问、不说”的态度仍然普遍存在于野生动物贸易领域，许多动物园乐于从碰巧拥有它们的人那里获得所需的东西。然而，这对一些涉及的生物造成了严重后果。莫尔特背着警察，曾在新泽西州的松林贫瘠之地活埋了一批动物，这个地方后来因《黑道家族》而臭名昭著。当他最终被捕时，克拉奇菲尔德将成为首选......

reflection.en: The documentary about rival reptile smugglers, likened to the "Tiger King" phenomenon, exposes a messy feud driven by intense rivalry and accusations. This kind of conflict often stems from a lack of humility, where individuals prioritize their own interests and perceived superiority. Yahweh calls us to a different path, urging us to value others above...
reflection.zh: 这部关于爬行动物走私犯之间激烈争斗的纪录片，被比作“虎王”现象，揭示了由强烈竞争和指控驱动的混乱恩怨。这种冲突往往源于缺乏谦卑，个人将自己的利益和自认为的优越感置于首位。雅伟呼召我们走一条不同的道路，敦促我们在分歧中也要看别人比自己强。

verse.textEn: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit. Rather, in humility value others above yourselves.
verse.textZh: 凡事不可结党，不可贪图虚浮的荣耀；只要存心谦卑，各人看别人比自己强。

title.en: Jeremy Thomas, Oscar-Winning Producer for Bertolucci and Cronenberg, Dead at 77
title.zh: 伯特鲁奇、克罗嫩伯格和赫尔佐格的《狂野的野马》的奥斯卡获奖制片人杰里米·托马斯去世，享年77岁

summary.en: Jeremy Thomas, the Oscar-winning producer of 'The Last Emperor,' has died at the age of 77. He was known for backing ambitious and memorable films throughout his nearly 60-year career and was featured in a new documentary about Bernardo Bertolucci that premiered at Venice.
summary.zh: 曾荣获奥斯卡奖的电影《末代皇帝》的制片人杰里米·托马斯（Jeremy Thomas）去世，享年77岁。他以在近60年的职业生涯中支持富有野心且令人难忘的电影而闻名，并且出现在一部关于贝纳尔多·贝托鲁奇的新纪录片中，该片在威尼斯电影节上首映。

body.en:

Jeremy Thomas put his weight behind some of the riskiest — and most fondly remembered — pictures in Hollywood across a nearly 60-year-long career. The UK-based Thomas died on September 11 at age 77, as confirmed by his family in a statement. ( Via Deadline .)

“Jeremy Thomas, the celebrated British producer of ‘The Last Emperor’ and of over 40 other films, has died, at the age of 77,” the statement reads. “Thomas passed away peacefully at his country home in Oxfordshire late on Friday 11th, surrounded by his family and loved ones.”

Thomas is best known for his collaborations with David Cronenberg (the kinky 1996 “Crash” that stoked jury president Francis Ford Coppola’s ire at the Cannes Film Festival), Bernardo Bertolucci (“The Last Emperor,” which won the Best Picture Oscar), Jonathan Glazer (“Sexy Beast”), Phillip Noyce (“Rabbit-Proof Fence”), and Jim Jarmusch (“Only Lovers Left Alive”), among other auteurs. Thomas also produced Nicolas Roeg’s trippy psychodrama “Bad Timing,” which continued the British director’s streak of brilliant offbeat arthouse movies after “Walkabout” and “Don’t Look Now.” Related Stories ‘The Julia Set’ Review: Chase Infiniti Is a Genius in a Movie Lacking Serious Brain Power ‘Iron Boy’ Review: A Beautifully Hand-Painted Coming-of-Age Story with a Dash of Magical Realism

Thomas also produced Cronenberg’s “A Dangerous Method” and “Naked Lunch.” He worked with Terry Gilliam on the auteur’s hugely controversial 2005 film “Tideland,” which starred Jeff Bridges and depicted a small child navigating a nightmarish adult world. Another of Thomas’ credits includes Nagisa Oshima’s “Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence,” from 1983, starring David Bowie, and now synonymous with Ryuichi Sakamoto’s piano score.

While not in attendance at this year’s fall fests, Thomas’ presence was felt in the selection in a couple of ways. He also produced Takashi Miike’s stab at the “Bad Lieutenant” universe (realized previously by Werner Herzog and Abel Ferrara over the years) with “Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo,” premiering this week at TIFF. Thomas is also one of the key talking heads in Luca Guadagnino’s seven-hour Venice documentary about Bernardo Bertolucci, “ Joie de Vivre...

reflection.en: Jeremy Thomas, a celebrated producer whose career spanned nearly six decades, has passed away at the age of 77. His life's work, marked by bold cinematic choices, leaves a lasting legacy. As we mark his passing, we are reminded of the finite nature of our time on earth, a universal truth that touches us all.
reflection.zh: 杰里米·托马斯（Jeremy Thomas）是一位备受赞誉的制片人，他的职业生涯跨越了近六十年，现已在77岁时离世。他以大胆的电影选择而闻名，其毕生成就留下了持久的印记。当我们纪念他的离去时，我们被提醒生命在世上的时间是有限的，这是一个触及我们所有人的普遍真理。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Fall Festival Movies Sold So Far: ‘Rapinoe’ About US Women’s Soccer Icon Lands at HBO Documentary Films
title.zh: 秋季电影节已售影片：《拉皮诺埃》讲述美国女足球明星的故事，被HBO纪录片公司购得

summary.en: Directed by Rebecca Huntt, the documentary about Megan Rapinoe premiered at TIFF on Thursday.
summary.zh: 由丽贝卡·亨特执导的关于梅根·拉皮诺埃的纪录片于周四在多伦多国际电影节首映。

body.en:

What will the buyers be snapping up at the fall festivals? With this year’s Toronto International Film Festival already touting a high number of premieres for movies that originally bowed at Cannes or Sundance, there’s fewer world premiere sales titles that aren’t already with distributors than we’re used to. Still, the festival (with its very first market in place), plus Telluride , Venice , and New York are loaded with options, and there’s always the potential for another historic breakout like last year’s “Obsession.”

We’ll be tracking all the sales as they come in here, so check back frequently.

Distributor : HBO Documentary Films Director : Rebecca Huntt Festival : TIFF Docs Buzz : “Rapinoe” about US Women’s National Soccer star Megan Rapinoe was the opening night documentary at TIFF. Rapinoe was in attendance at the premiere screening of director Rebecca Huntt’s (“Beba”) film, which grapples more with Rapinoe’s progressive politics, such as her kneeling in solidarity with Colin Kaepernick, and her coming out story, than it does on the stories from her soccer career about how she led the US Women’s team to two World Cup titles, an Olympics Gold, and the Ballon d’Or. HBO Documentary Films has North American TV and streaming rights to the film. THR first reported the news. Related Stories Is Josh Giuliano the Next Curry Barker or Kane Parsons? Blumhouse Atomic Monster Seems to Think So From Nathan Fielder’s Buzzy Elizabeth Holmes Doc to Robert Pattinson’s Divisive ‘Primetime’: Venice and Telluride’s Winners and Losers

Distributor : Roadside Attractions and Vertical Director : Lauren Miller Rogen Festival : TIFF Gala Presentation Buzz : Lauren Miller Rogen directs her husband Seth Rogen alongside Anna Kendrick and Kate Berlant in this comedy about parenthood and prospective parenthood. It follows a childless couple who begin debating the merits of having kids when their divorced friend and her child move in with them. The cast is stacked, including Issa Rae, Dan Stevens, Zach Cherry, Ed Helms, Ashley Park, Sharon Stone, and David Strathairn in supporting parts.

“Babies” is described as heartfelt and poignant in what is shaping up to be a strong year for Seth Rogen. The movie launched sales at TIFF nearly a year to the date prior to its Roy Thomson Hall premiere. The distributors are planning for a release in early...

title.en: How Two Oscars Breakouts Are Charting New Paths for Indian Cinema at TIFF with ‘Dorothy’ and ‘Termite’
title.zh: 两位奥斯卡获奖者如何以《桃乐茜》和《白蚁》为 TIFF 印度电影开辟新道路

summary.en: At TIFF, director Karthik Subbaraj and producer Guneet Monga Kapoor discuss the unique qualities of their large-scale Tamil gangster film 'Dorothy.' Meanwhile, Shaunak Sen talks about 'Termite,' his first venture into directing fiction, and a documentary feature he is co-producing with Joaquin Phoenix.
summary.zh: 在多伦多国际电影节（TIFF）上，《桃乐茜》的导演 Karthik Subbaraj 和制片人 Guneet Monga Kapoor 揭示了这部大制作的泰米尔黑帮片为何如此特别。同时，Shaunak Sen 讨论了他的首部虚构作品《白蚁》，以及他与 Joaquin Phoenix 联合制作的一部纪录长片。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

You might remember the 2023 Academy Awards for the ascendance of “Everything Everywhere All At Once.” But it was also a historic year for Indian cinema. The stateside craze over “RRR,” the Telugu-language Indian action bonanza, reached a crescendo when it danced its way to the Oscar for Best Original Song. Another winner that evening was producer Guneet Monga Kapoor, nabbing the Oscar for Documentary Short for “ The Elephant Whisperers .” Shaunak Sen ’s “ All That Breathes ” was also nominated for Documentary Feature after winning top prizes at Sundance and Cannes. The South Asian community had plenty to cheer about that night. Related Stories ‘Burgundy’ Review: A Warm, Witty Winemaking Vibe Documentary You’ll Want to Pair with a Glass of Red One of the Year’s Best Film Books Celebrates the Unsung Artists That Turned ‘The Women’ Into a Classic

As the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival rolls around, the community again has much to be excited about, with nearly a dozen films from the subcontinent across the lineup. Sen and Monga Kapoor will meet in Toronto again, each celebrating a career milestone with their premieres on Friday.

“Termite,” a poetic short about a Delhi exterminator whose roommate gets an unexpected marriage proposal, is Sen’s first film as a director after “All That Breathes,” and his fiction debut. Monga Kapoor unveils “Dorothy,” a gangster western directed by Karthik Subbaraj, making it the first feature from the renowned Tamil director to premiere at a major festival. His previous nine, including “Mercury” and “Jigarthanda,” had direct theatrical releases. Significantly, “Dorothy” is Monga Kapoor’s first film after India’s leading entertainment company, Jio Studios (the content arm of Reliance Industries), acquired a majority stake in her and Achin Jain’s storied production company, Sikhya Entertainment, earlier this year.

“Dorothy” and “Termite” could not be more different, and their paths to TIFF illustrate the fascinating contrasts in creative collaborations, financing landscapes, and visions behind the slates built by Sikhya as a studio and KiteRabbit, the production company Sen and his producing partner Aman Mann started with “All That Breathes.” IndieWire caught up with Sen, Monga Kapoor, and Subbaraj the week before TIFF, as...

reflection.en: The dedication of filmmakers like Karthik Subbaraj and Shaunak Sen to their craft, pushing the boundaries of Indian cinema, embodies the pursuit of knowledge and understanding. Their work at festivals like TIFF showcases a commitment to learning and innovation, mirroring the wisdom found in seeking understanding.
reflection.zh: Karthik Subbaraj 和 Shaunak Sen 等电影制作人对其技艺的投入，以及他们拓展印度电影的边界，体现了对知识和理解的追求。他们在多伦多国际电影节等电影节上的工作，展现了对学习和创新的承诺，这与寻求理解的智慧相呼应。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。
